a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:0;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:169:"

Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the fettuccine until al dente according to package instructions. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water before draining.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:245:"

Pat shrimp dry and season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook shrimp 1–2 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Remove shrimp from pan and set aside. Do not overcook.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:2;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:282:"

Reduce heat to medium. In the same skillet, sauté garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and chicken broth, simmering for 3–4 minutes until slightly thickened. Stir in Parmesan cheese and Italian seasoning. Add lemon juice and adjust seasoning to taste.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:3;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:199:"

Return shrimp to the pan. Add drained pasta and toss gently to coat in the sauce. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if needed to loosen. Cook together for 1–2 minutes until well combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:4;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:95:"

Garnish with chopped parsley and extra Parmesan. Serve immediately while hot and creamy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use freshly grated Parmesan for smoother melting and better flavor. Pat shrimp dry before cooking to achieve a light sear. If the sauce thickens too much, gradually add warm reserved pasta water. For extra depth, deglaze the pan with a splash of white wine before adding the cream. Not ideal for freezing due to cream separation.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Rainbow Swirl Sugar Cookies
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These vibrant rainbow swirl sugar cookies are buttery, soft, and beautifully colorful. Made with a simple vanilla sugar cookie dough and gel food coloring, they can be shaped into stunning swirl or marble patterns — perfect for holidays, parties, and special occasions.
item.category: gel food coloring (red, blue, yellow, green, purple, or desired colors)

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:8:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:32:"unsalted butter, softened (225g)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:154;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:23:"granulated sugar (200g)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:155;}i:2;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:9:"large egg";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:156;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:15:"vanilla extract";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:59;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"2 1/2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:24:"all-purpose flour (315g)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:158;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:13:"baking powder";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:159;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:4:"salt";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:36;}i:7;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:71:"gel food coloring (red, blue, yellow, green, purple, or desired colors)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:160;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:279:"

Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, about 2–3 minutes. Add egg and vanilla extract and mix until combined. In a separate bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add dry ingredients to the butter mixture and mix until a soft dough forms.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:184:"

Divide dough evenly into 3–5 portions depending on desired colors. Add gel food coloring to each portion and knead gently until evenly colored. Use gloves to prevent staining.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:255:"

For swirl style, roll each colored dough into similar rectangles, stack, and roll tightly into a log. For marble style, lightly twist different colored pieces together and roll into a log. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and chill for at least 1 hour.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:207:"

Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). Slice chilled dough into 1/4-inch thick rounds and place on a parchment-lined baking tray 2 inches apart. Bake for 10–12 minutes until edges are set but not browned.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:109:"

Allow cookies to cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use gel food coloring rather than liquid to avoid altering dough texture. Chill the dough thoroughly to keep colors distinct. For extra brightness, use white sugar instead of brown sugar. If colors blend too much, chill between each handling step. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 5 days. Dough log can be frozen for up to 2 months and sliced before baking.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Galaxy Chocolate Chip Cookie (Purple & Cosmic Style)
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A thick, bakery-style double chocolate cookie with a rich dark cocoa base and vibrant purple, blue, and pink chocolate chips. Soft and fudgy in the center with slightly crisp edges, these cosmic cookies are perfect for themed parties and eye-catching dessert tables.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:12:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:0;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:32:"unsalted butter, softened a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:0;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:93:"

Beat butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar until light and fluffy (2–3 minutes).

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:66:"

Mix in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla extract and combine.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:2;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:172:"

In a separate bowl, whisk flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, salt, and cornstarch. Gradually mix dry ingredients into wet mixture until just combined. Do not overmix.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:3;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:109:"

Reserve a small handful of colorful chips for topping. Gently fold the remaining chips into the dough.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:4;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:105:"

Refrigerate dough for at least 45 minutes. This step ensures thick cookies and prevents spreading.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:5;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:184:"

Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). Scoop large dough balls (about 3 tablespoons each) and place on lined baking sheet. Press extra colorful chips on top for a bakery-style finish.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:6;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:153:"

Bake for 11–13 minutes. Edges should be set but centers slightly soft. Let cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For thicker cookies, chill the dough up to 2 hours. Slightly underbake for a fudgy center. If colored chips are unavailable, use white chocolate chips tinted with oil-based food coloring. Sprinkle edible glitter before baking for a cosmic effect. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for 4–5 days. Freeze dough balls up to 2 months or baked cookies up to 1 month.

item.title: Blackberry & Toasted Marshmallow Milkshake
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This blackberry and toasted marshmallow milkshake is rich, creamy, and slightly tangy with deep berry flavor balanced by sweet toasted marshmallow. It features a vibrant blackberry syrup swirl, a smooth vanilla-berry shake base, and a fluffy toasted marshmallow topping for a dramatic finish.
item.category: whipped cream or marshmallow fluff (for topping)

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:5:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:112;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:14:"small saucepan";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:113;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:7:"blender";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:114;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:20:"tall serving glasses";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:182;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:21:"fine sieve (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:16:"For smooth syrup";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:183;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"kitchen torch";s:5:"notes";s:25:"For toasting marshmallows";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:11:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:0;s:6:"amount";s:5:"1 1/2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:35:"fresh or frozen blackberries (200g)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:184;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"3";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:5:"sugar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:37;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:2;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:11:"lemon juice";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:117;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:3;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:5:"water";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:30;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:4;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:17:"vanilla ice cream";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:185;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:5;s:6:"amount";s:3:"3/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:15:"cold whole milk";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:118;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:6;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:33:"blackberry syrup (prepared above)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:186;}i:7;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:7;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:15:"vanilla extract";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:59;}i:8;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:8;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:48:"whipped cream or marshmallow fluff (for topping)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:187;}i:9;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:9;s:6:"amount";s:5:"4–6";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:18:"large marshmallows";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:188;}i:10;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:10;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:32:"fresh blackberries (for garnish)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:189;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:0;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:264:"

In a saucepan over medium heat, combine blackberries, sugar, lemon juice, and water. Cook for 6–8 minutes until berries break down and the mixture thickens slightly. Strain through a fine sieve for a smooth syrup if desired, then allow to cool completely.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:219:"

Spoon several tablespoons of blackberry syrup inside each serving glass. Tilt and rotate the glass to create dramatic streaks along the sides. Place the glasses in the freezer for 5–10 minutes to set the swirl.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:2;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:241:"

In a blender, combine vanilla ice cream, cold whole milk, 1/2 cup blackberry syrup, and vanilla extract. Blend until thick and smooth. Adjust consistency by adding more milk for a thinner shake or more ice cream for a thicker texture.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:3;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:82:"

Pour the milkshake into the prepared glasses with the set blackberry swirl.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:4;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:193:"

Top with whipped cream or marshmallow fluff. Place marshmallows on top and carefully toast with a kitchen torch until golden brown. Garnish with fresh blackberries and serve immediately.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For deeper flavor, add a pinch of salt to the syrup. Freeze glasses beforehand to keep the shake colder longer. If you do not have a torch, toast marshmallows briefly under a broiler. For a darker color, blend in a few whole blackberries directly into the shake. Best served immediately. Blackberry syrup can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 5 days.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Easy Taco Cups (My Weeknight Secret Weapon!)
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: Crispy tortilla cups baked in a muffin tin, filled with seasoned beef, tomato sauce, corn, and black beans, then topped with melty cheddar. Fun, fast, and way less messy than regular tacos — perfect for busy weeknights.
item.category: canned black beans, rinsed and drained
small flour tortillas, cut into rounds

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:277:"

Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Cut tortillas into circles (using a round cutter or the rim of a glass) and press each round into the wells of a muffin tin. Lightly brush with olive oil for extra crispiness. Bake for about 8 minutes, until just starting to turn golden.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:186:"

Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion and garlic until soft and fragrant. Add the ground beef and brown. Stir in taco seasoning and tomato sauce.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:96:"

Add the corn and black beans and cook for a couple of minutes, just until warmed through.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:205:"

Spoon the filling into the baked tortilla cups (don’t overfill). Top generously with shredded cheddar. Return the muffin tin to the oven for 10–12 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:94:"

Cool in the tin for a few minutes before removing. Add desired toppings and serve warm.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Tips: Nonstick muffin tins work best. Press tortillas firmly into the wells so they hold a true cup shape. Don’t skip the first bake on the tortilla shells — it prevents soggy cups.

Make ahead: The filling keeps in the fridge for up to 2 days. Assemble and bake when ready. Leftovers reheat best in the oven to keep the shells crisp.

For serving: Sour cream, diced tomatoes, shredded lettuce, sliced green onions.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Homemade Shamrock Shake (Better Than the Drive-Thru!)
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This homemade Shamrock Shake is creamy, minty, and ready in just 5 minutes. Made with real vanilla ice cream, whole milk, and mint extract (not peppermint!), it tastes even better than the drive-thru version — and you can make two at once without leaving the house.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:7:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"3";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:17:"vanilla ice cream";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:185;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"3/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:10:"whole milk";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:220;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:12:"mint extract";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:221;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:6:"5–10";s:4:"unit";s:5:"drops";s:4:"name";s:19:"green food coloring";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:222;s:2:"id";i:223;}i:4;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:26:"whipped cream, for topping";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:122;}i:5;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:32:"maraschino cherries, for topping";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:224;}i:6;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:26:"green sprinkles (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:225;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:108:"

Add the vanilla ice cream, whole milk, mint extract, and 5 drops of green food coloring to a blender.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:141:"

Blend until smooth and creamy. Check the color and add additional drops of food coloring until your desired shade of green is reached.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:42:"

Pour into tall glasses immediately.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:83:"

Top with whipped cream, a maraschino cherry, and green sprinkles if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:53:"

Serve immediately for best texture and flavor.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use mint extract for the classic Shamrock Shake flavor — peppermint is stronger and should be reduced if substituted. Start with 5 drops of green food coloring and adjust to your preferred shade; gel coloring is more concentrated than liquid. For a thicker shake, reduce the milk and add gradually. For a thinner consistency, add a splash more milk. Optional adult variation: blend in a shot of Baileys or crème de menthe. Leftovers can be frozen up to 1 month, but texture is best when freshly blended.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Mint Chocolate Cheesecake
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This mint chocolate cheesecake features a rich chocolate cookie crust and a creamy peppermint-infused filling with a soft green hue. Cool, smooth, and perfectly balanced, it is an elegant yet easy dessert for dinners, birthdays, or holiday gatherings.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:11:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:23:"chocolate cookie crumbs";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:235;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:16:"granulated sugar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:45;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:23:"unsalted butter, melted";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:236;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:2:"24";s:4:"unit";s:2:"oz";s:4:"name";s:31:"full fat cream cheese, softened";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:56;s:2:"id";i:237;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:16:"granulated sugar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:45;}i:5;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"3";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:28:"large eggs, room temperature";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:238;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:28:"sour cream, room temperature";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:239;}i:7;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:15:"vanilla extract";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:59;}i:8;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:9:"1–1 1/2";s:4:"unit";s:9:"teaspoons";s:4:"name";s:18:"peppermint extract";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:170;s:2:"id";i:240;}i:9;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:23:"green gel food coloring";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:241;}i:10;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:31:"mini chocolate chips (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:242;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:136:"

Preheat your oven to 160°C (325°F). Lightly grease a 9 inch springform pan and line the bottom with parchment paper if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:200:"

In a medium bowl, stir together the chocolate cookie crumbs, sugar, and melted butter until evenly moistened. Press firmly into the bottom of the pan and bake for 10 minutes. Set aside to cool.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:187:"

In a large mixing bowl, beat the softened cream cheese until completely smooth. Add the sugar and mix until combined. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing gently after each addition.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:191:"

Stir in the sour cream, vanilla extract, and peppermint extract. Add green gel food coloring a drop at a time until you reach a soft minty shade. Fold in mini chocolate chips if using.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:226:"

Pour the filling over the cooled crust and smooth the top. Bake for 55 to 65 minutes until the edges are set and the center still slightly wobbles. Turn off the oven, crack the door open, and let cool inside for 1 hour.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:130:"

Remove from the oven and cool completely at room temperature. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight before serving.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Make sure all ingredients are at room temperature for the smoothest texture. Do not overmix after adding the eggs to avoid incorporating excess air. Cool the cheesecake slowly in the oven with the door slightly open to help prevent cracks. Refrigerate at least 4 hours, preferably overnight. Store covered in the refrigerator up to 5 days or freeze well wrapped and thaw overnight in the refrigerator.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Irish Stout–Braised Corned Beef Cheek Sliders
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These Irish Stout–Braised Corned Beef Cheek Sliders are a rich and cozy twist on a St Patrick’s Day classic. Home-cured beef cheeks are slow-braised in Guinness, piled onto soft slider buns, and finished with caramelized onion butter and bright pickled slaw.

vinegar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:271;}i:21;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:5:"sugar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:37;}i:22;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:5:"pinch";s:4:"name";s:4:"salt";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:268;s:2:"id";i:36;}i:23;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:2:"12";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:23:"mini potato slider buns";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:272;}i:24;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:32:"whole grain mustard, for serving";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:273;}i:25;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:35:"fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:143;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:329:"

In a bowl, mix together the curing salt, kosher salt, brown sugar, pepper, mustard seeds, coriander, bay leaves, and garlic. Rub this mixture all over the beef cheeks. Place them in a covered container in the refrigerator for 3 to 5 days, turning once a day. When ready to cook, rinse the beef thoroughly under cold water.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:302:"

Preheat your oven to 325°F (160°C). Place the cured beef cheeks in a Dutch oven with the onion, carrot, and celery. Pour in the stout until the meat is mostly covered. Cover tightly and braise for 3½ to 4 hours, until the meat is fork tender and silky. Let rest slightly, then shred or slice.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:292:"

In a skillet over medium low heat, cook the sliced onions in 2 tablespoons butter for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deep golden brown. Add the stout and simmer until thick and syrupy. Let cool, then fold into the softened butter with a pinch of salt. Chill until firm.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:158:"

Mix the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a bowl. Toss with the sliced ramps and cabbage. Let sit for at least 30 minutes until slightly softened and bright.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:188:"

Lightly toast the slider buns. Spread Guinness onion butter on both sides. Add shredded beef cheek, then pickled slaw. Finish with whole grain mustard and fresh parsley. Serve warm.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Beef cheeks require 3 to 5 days of curing time before cooking. You can cure for the full 5 days for deeper flavor. The onion butter can be made a day ahead and chilled. Sliders can be assembled just before serving for best texture.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Emerald Matcha & Pistachio Irish Cream Affogato
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This elegant St. Patrick’s Day dessert-drink hybrid combines earthy ceremonial matcha, creamy pistachio gelato, and smooth Irish cream liqueur. Hot whisked matcha is poured affogato-style over cold gelato, creating a vibrant green swirl finished with chopped pistachios and white chocolate for a refined seasonal treat.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:3:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:279;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:36:"matcha whisk (chasen) or small whisk";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:280;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:14:"heatproof bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:281;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:29:"small glasses or dessert cups";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:8:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:30:"ceremonial-grade matcha powder";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:282;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"120";s:4:"unit";s:2:"ml";s:4:"name";s:26:"hot water (175°F / 80°C)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:28;s:2:"id";i:283;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:25:"honey or sugar (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:284;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:12:"large scoops";s:4:"name";s:29:"pistachio gelato or ice cream";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:285;s:2:"id";i:286;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:19:"Irish cream liqueur";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:287;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:25:"finely chopped pistachios";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:288;}i:6;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:35:"white chocolate shavings (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:289;}i:7;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:30:"light dusting of matcha powder";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:290;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:4:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:179:"

Sift the matcha powder into a bowl to remove clumps. Add the hot water and whisk vigorously in a zigzag motion until frothy. Sweeten lightly with honey or sugar if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:134:"

Place one large scoop of pistachio gelato into each serving glass. Drizzle 1 tablespoon of Irish cream liqueur over each scoop.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:137:"

Pour the hot matcha evenly over each scoop to create the affogato effect. The gelato will melt into a creamy, vibrant green swirl.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:131:"

Top with chopped pistachios, white chocolate shavings, and a light dusting of matcha powder. Serve immediately with a spoon.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use high-quality ceremonial matcha for the best color and smooth flavor. Warm the serving glasses slightly to allow the gelato to melt gradually. For a stronger and creamier variation, replace part of the water with hot milk for a matcha latte-style pour. To make it non-alcoholic, substitute Irish cream with vanilla cream and a drop of almond extract. For a vegan version, use dairy-free gelato and plant milk. Best enjoyed immediately for the perfect hot-and-cold contrast.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Cajun Sausage Soup
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This Cajun Sausage Soup is a bold, comforting one-pot meal packed with smoky andouille sausage, tender potatoes, beans, corn, and the classic Cajun “holy trinity” of onion, bell pepper, and celery. Gently spiced with paprika, thyme, oregano, and cayenne, it delivers layered flavor with just the right amount of heat. Perfect for chilly evenings and even better the next day.
item.category: large heavy bottomed pot or Dutch oven
red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
smoked andouille sausage, sliced into 1/2 inch rounds
Yukon gold or russet potatoes, peeled and cubed

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:265:"

Heat the olive oil in a large heavy bottomed pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the sliced sausage in a single layer and brown for 3 to 4 minutes per side until caramelized. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving the rendered fat in the pot.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:273:"

Add the onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, and celery to the same pot. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Stir in paprika, smoked paprika, thyme, oregano, and cayenne, coating the vegetables well.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:194:"

Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Add the diced tomatoes with their juices, scraping up browned bits. Pour in the chicken broth and add the bay leaf. Bring to a gentle boil.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:271:"

Add the cubed potatoes and return the sausage to the pot. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes until potatoes are fork tender. Stir in corn and kidney beans and simmer 8 to 10 minutes more. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:152:"

For a thicker soup, gently mash a few potato pieces against the side of the pot. For a brothier texture, add extra warm chicken broth as desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:167:"

Remove the bay leaf. Ladle into bowls and top with sliced green onions and fresh parsley. Add hot sauce if desired and serve hot with crusty bread or cornbread.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use high-quality smoked andouille sausage for the best flavor. Let the vegetables soften fully before adding liquids to develop depth. For a thicker soup, mash a few potato pieces against the side of the pot. For a brothier texture, add extra warm chicken broth. This soup tastes even better the next day. Add cooked rice to each bowl for a heartier variation. Store in the refrigerator up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Tuscan Creamy Sun Dried Tomato Chicken
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This Tuscan creamy sun dried tomato chicken is a rich, comforting one-pan dinner made with golden seared chicken breasts simmered in a silky garlic parmesan cream sauce with sun dried tomatoes and fresh spinach. The sauce is savory, slightly tangy, and perfect served over pasta, rice, or with crusty bread.

(optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:338;}i:19;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:32:"fresh basil, chopped for a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:233:"

Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt, pepper, paprika, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder. If the chicken breasts are very thick, gently pound them to an even thickness for even cooking.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:239:"

Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add the chicken breasts and cook undisturbed for about 5 to 6 minutes until a golden crust forms. Flip and cook another 5 minutes. Remove the chicken and set aside.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:181:"

Reduce heat to medium. Add the diced onion to the same pan and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:154:"

Add the sliced sun dried tomatoes and mushrooms if using. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for about 1 minute while stirring to deepen the flavor.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:156:"

Pour in the chicken broth and scrape the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon to release the browned bits. Let it simmer briefly to reduce slightly.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:175:"

Stir in the heavy cream, parmesan cheese, oregano, basil, and red pepper flakes. Simmer gently for 4 to 6 minutes until the sauce becomes smooth and slightly thickened.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:288:"

Add the fresh spinach and stir until wilted. Return the chicken and its juices to the skillet and spoon sauce over the top. Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and the sauce thickens. Finish with fresh basil, black pepper, and extra parmesan before serving.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Do not rush the chicken browning stage because the golden crust builds the base flavor of the sauce. Freshly grated parmesan melts more smoothly and provides better flavor than pre-shredded cheese. If the sauce thickens too much while simmering, add a splash of warm chicken broth or cream to loosen it. Store leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days and reheat gently with a little extra broth or cream to restore the sauce.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Slow Braised Garlic Herb Pot Roast with Vegetables
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This slow braised garlic herb pot roast is a comforting classic made with tender beef chuck, aromatic vegetables, and a rich savory broth. Slowly cooked in the oven, the beef becomes fork-tender while potatoes and carrots absorb the deep flavors of garlic, herbs, red wine, and beef broth.
item.category: Dutch oven or heavy oven-safe pot
Yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:8:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:189:"

Remove the beef from the refrigerator about 20 minutes before cooking. Pat the roast dry with paper towels and season all sides with salt, black pepper, paprika, thyme, and rosemary.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:215:"

Preheat the oven to 160°C (325°F). Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the roast for about 4–5 minutes on each side until a deep golden crust forms, then remove and set aside.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:238:"

In the same pot, add the sliced onion, carrots, and celery. Cook for 5–6 minutes until they begin to soften. Add the smashed garlic and cook for another minute, then stir in the tomato paste and cook briefly to deepen the flavor.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:169:"

Pour in the red wine and scrape the bottom of the pot with a wooden spoon to release the browned bits. Let the wine simmer for about 3 minutes to reduce slightly.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:184:"

Add the beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, and bay leaves. Return the seared roast to the pot so the liquid comes about halfway up the meat. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:249:"

Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven. Braise for about 2 hours. Add the potatoes and additional carrots, spooning some of the liquid over them, then return the pot to the oven and cook another 1–1½ hours until the beef is fork-tender.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:251:"

Remove the roast and vegetables to a serving platter. If a thicker sauce is desired, simmer the liquid on the stove and whisk in a paste made from butter and flour. Cook for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened and adjust seasoning if needed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:7;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 8";s:4:"text";s:168:"

Slice or gently shred the pot roast and arrange it with the vegetables. Spoon the sauce over the top and sprinkle with fresh chopped parsley before serving warm.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Chuck roast works best because it becomes very tender during long cooking. If the roast is not fork-tender after the suggested cooking time, continue cooking for another 20–30 minutes. The flavor improves even more the next day, making this an excellent make-ahead meal. Store leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or freeze portions with sauce for up to 3 months.

item.title: Honey Garlic Glazed Chicken Thighs
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This honey garlic glazed chicken is a comforting and flavorful dinner made with crispy roasted chicken thighs coated in a sticky sweet and savory garlic sauce. The honey caramelizes beautifully in the oven while soy sauce and garlic create a rich glaze that pairs perfectly with rice, vegetables, or mashed potatoes.
item.category: oven safe skillet or baking dish
rice vinegar or apple cider vinegar

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:110:"

Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease an oven safe skillet or baking dish with olive oil.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:202:"

Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt and black pepper. Place the thighs skin side up in the prepared skillet or baking dish, leaving space between each piece.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:137:"

Place the chicken in the oven and roast for about 25 minutes until the skin begins to turn golden and some of the fat renders out.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:192:"

While the chicken roasts, combine honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, vinegar, brown sugar, and ground ginger in a small saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat while stirring.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:224:"

Whisk together cornstarch and water in a small bowl to create a slurry. Slowly pour it into the simmering sauce while whisking and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the sauce thickens and becomes glossy. Remove from heat.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:341:"

Remove the chicken from the oven after 25 minutes. Spoon about half of the honey garlic sauce over the chicken, coating each piece. Return to the oven and roast for another 15 to 20 minutes. Spoon sauce from the pan over the chicken during the last minutes to build a glaze. Cook until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:171:"

Remove the chicken from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes. Drizzle remaining sauce over the top and garnish with sesame seeds and chopped green onions if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For extra crispy chicken skin, place the finished chicken under the broiler for 2 to 3 minutes at the end of cooking. Watch carefully so the honey glaze does not burn. This creates a deeper caramelized finish and an even stickier glaze.

item.title: Easy Garlic Butter Lobster Tail
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: Lobster Tail with Garlic Butter is an elegant but easy oven-baked seafood dish with tender, juicy lobster topped and basted with rich garlic butter, lemon, and fresh herbs. It is perfect for holidays, special dinners, or any meal that feels a little extra without being complicated.
item.category: fresh dill or extra herbs, for garnish (optional)

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:9:{i:0;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"lobster tails";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:382;}i:1;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:14:"salt, to taste";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:383;}i:2;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:22:"black pepper, to taste";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:384;}i:3;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:25:"lemon wedges, for serving";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:385;}i:4;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:49:"fresh dill or extra herbs, for garnish (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:386;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"4";s:4:"unit";s:11:"tablespoons";s:4:"name";s:15:"unsalted butter";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:387;s:2:"id";i:388;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"3";s:4:"unit";s:6:"cloves";s:4:"name";s:14:"garlic, minced";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:76;s:2:"id";i:77;}i:7;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:10:"tablespoon";s:4:"name";s:22:"fresh parsley, chopped";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:174;s:2:"id";i:322;}i:8;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:11:"lemon juice";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:117;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:4:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:296:"

Preheat your oven to 425°F (220°C). Using kitchen shears, carefully cut down the top of each lobster shell, stopping near the base. Gently loosen the meat and lift it up so it rests on top of the shell, creating a butterflied look. Be careful not to fully detach the meat from the shell.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:249:"

In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, just until fragrant. Remove from the heat, then stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:301:"

Place the prepared lobster tails in a baking dish. Brush the lobster meat generously with about half of the garlic butter. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the meat is opaque and cooked through. While baking, baste the lobster once or twice with the remaining garlic butter to keep it juicy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:177:"

Remove the lobster tails from the oven and garnish with fresh parsley or dill if desired. Serve with lemon wedges and any remaining garlic butter on the side for dipping.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use fresh lobster tails for the best flavor and texture, but fully thawed frozen tails work very well too. Be careful not to overcook the lobster or it may become tough. Basting once or twice during baking helps keep the meat moist and flavorful. For variation, add smoked paprika or cayenne to the butter, swap parsley for dill, chives, or basil, or use olive oil or dairy-free butter instead of regular butter. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days and reheat gently.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Lemon Ricotta Pasta
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This lemon ricotta pasta is a light yet comforting dish made with creamy ricotta, bright lemon zest, and savory Parmesan cheese. The sauce becomes silky when tossed with warm pasta and a splash of pasta water, creating a simple but elegant meal perfect for weeknight dinners or relaxed gatherings.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:5:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:130;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:9:"large pot";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:429;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:8:"colander";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:248;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:11:"mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:131;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:27:"large skillet or sauté pan";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:396;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:19:"tongs or pasta fork";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

(optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:436;}i:11;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:28:"red pepper flakes (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:336;}i:12;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:33:"extra Parmesan cheese for serving";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:340;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:292:"

Fill a large pot with water and bring it to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, add a generous amount of salt so the water tastes lightly salty. Add the pasta and cook according to package instructions until al dente. Before draining, reserve about one cup of the pasta cooking water.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:209:"

In a medium mixing bowl combine the ricotta cheese, grated Parmesan cheese, lemon zest, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Whisk until the mixture becomes smooth and creamy, then set aside.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:228:"

Heat a large skillet over medium heat with a small drizzle of olive oil. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to let it brown. Add red pepper flakes at this stage if using.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:187:"

Transfer the cooked pasta directly into the skillet with the garlic. Add about 1/4 cup of the reserved pasta water and toss gently to loosen everything and begin forming the sauce.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:254:"

Remove the skillet from direct heat and add the ricotta mixture. Toss everything together with tongs until the pasta is fully coated and creamy. If the sauce is too thick, add a little more pasta water and continue tossing until glossy and smooth.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:219:"

If using peas or sautéed spinach, stir them in now. Divide the pasta among bowls and finish with extra grated Parmesan, a drizzle of olive oil, cracked black pepper, and a little extra lemon zest before serving.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use whole milk ricotta for the creamiest texture. Always zest the lemon before juicing for easier preparation. Do not skip the reserved pasta water — the starch helps the sauce cling beautifully to the pasta. Optional additions like peas or sautéed spinach add color and extra flavor while keeping the dish light.

a:3:{s:4:"type";s:7:"warning";s:7:"message";s:67:"There are no ratings for your recipe.

item.title: Coconut Tamarind Braised Chicken with Fragrant Rice
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A cozy yet vibrant braised chicken dish with tender bone-in chicken thighs simmered in a silky coconut tamarind sauce with garlic, ginger, and warm spices, served over fragrant jasmine rice.
item.category: full fat coconut milk (14 oz / 400 ml)
large deep skillet or Dutch oven
thinly sliced red chili, for garnish (optional)

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:8:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:308:"

In a medium saucepan, combine the jasmine rice, water, and salt. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes. Turn off the heat and let the rice sit covered for another 10 minutes before fluffing with a fork. Set aside while the chicken cooks.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:103:"

Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Season them with salt, black pepper, and turmeric.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:297:"

Heat the vegetable oil in a large deep skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Place the chicken thighs skin side down and cook for about 5 to 6 minutes until the skin becomes golden brown. Turn the chicken and cook for another 3 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:285:"

In the same pan, add the chopped onion and cook for about 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and grated ginger and cook for another 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the tomato paste, coriander, cumin, and smoked paprika, then cook for about 1 minute to toast the spices.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:222:"

Add the tamarind paste and brown sugar, stirring to combine. Pour in the coconut milk and chicken broth while stirring, scraping the bottom of the pan to release any browned bits. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:237:"

Return the chicken thighs to the pan, nestling them into the sauce. Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover partially, and let the chicken simmer for about 25 to 30 minutes. Occasionally spoon some sauce over the chicken as it cooks.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:128:"

Taste the sauce and adjust with a pinch of salt if needed. For a brighter finish, add a squeeze of lime juice if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:7;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 8";s:4:"text";s:195:"

Spoon jasmine rice onto each plate. Top with a chicken thigh and ladle plenty of coconut tamarind sauce over it. Garnish with fresh cilantro, sliced red chili, and a lime wedge if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Bone-in chicken thighs work best because they stay juicy during braising. If tamarind paste is unavailable, use a small splash of lime juice with a little extra brown sugar to mimic the sweet-tangy balance. Leftovers keep well in the refrigerator for up to 3 days and taste even better the next day. Reheat gently with a splash of water or broth if the sauce thickens too much.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Easy California Roll Cucumber Salad
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: If you love California rolls but do not feel like fussing with rolling sushi at home, this easy cucumber salad is a fresh and satisfying fix. It combines crunchy cucumber, imitation crab, creamy avocado, mayonnaise, cream cheese, soy sauce, and toasted sesame seeds for a quick sushi-inspired lunch or light dinner.
item.category: imitation crab, chopped into bite-sized pieces
large deli container, jar, or mixing bowl

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:4:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:463;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:23:"mandolin or sharp knife";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:99;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"cutting board";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:464;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:41:"large deli container, jar, or mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:465;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:19:"lid or mixing spoon";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:7:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:5:"large";s:4:"name";s:23:"cucumber, thinly sliced";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:302;s:2:"id";i:466;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"4";s:4:"unit";s:6:"sticks";s:4:"name";s:46:"imitation crab, chopped into bite-sized pieces";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:467;s:2:"id";i:468;}i:2;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:14:"avocado, cubed";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:469;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:10:"mayonnaise";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:470;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:22:"cream cheese, softened";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:471;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"1 1/2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:9:"soy sauce";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:369;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:20:"toasted sesame seeds";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:472;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:4:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:185:"

Using a mandolin or a sharp knife, slice the cucumber into thin rounds, about 1/8 inch thick. Thin slices give the salad a light texture and help the flavors mix together evenly.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:199:"

Place the sliced cucumber in a large deli container, jar, or mixing bowl. Add the chopped imitation crab, cubed avocado, mayonnaise, softened cream cheese, soy sauce, and toasted sesame seeds.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:251:"

If using a container or jar with a lid, seal it tightly and shake until everything is well coated. If using a bowl, stir gently until the dressing is evenly mixed and the cucumber is nicely coated. Do not overmix so the avocado keeps its shape.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:106:"

Serve right away for the freshest texture and flavor. Top with a few extra sesame seeds if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

English cucumber works best for this salad because it has a thin skin, fewer seeds, and a crisp texture. If using regular cucumbers, peel and seed them first to avoid excess moisture. For the best texture, serve the salad right away and add the avocado just before serving. If needed, salt watery cucumber slices lightly, let them drain for 15 to 20 minutes, and pat dry before mixing. This salad is best enjoyed the same day and should be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 24 hours.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Moroccan Chicken with Preserved Lemon and Olives
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This Moroccan chicken with preserved lemon and olives is a fragrant, comforting one-pan dish where tender chicken slowly simmers with warm spices, garlic, onions, and bright citrusy preserved lemon. The result is a rich and savory sauce with hints of turmeric, ginger, and cumin that pairs beautifully with couscous, rice, or warm bread.
item.category: large skillet or Dutch oven with lid
preserved lemon peel, finely chopped (pulp removed)

chopped";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:483;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:257:"

Pat the chicken pieces dry with paper towels. In a small bowl mix the salt, black pepper, turmeric, ginger, cumin, and paprika. Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken and let it rest for about 10 minutes while preparing the remaining ingredients.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:245:"

Heat olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Place the chicken skin side down and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and slightly crisp. Turn and cook another 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer the browned chicken to a plate.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:198:"

Add the sliced onions to the same pan and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly golden. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:194:"

Add the chopped preserved lemon peel and green olives to the pan. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan to build flavor in the sauce.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:183:"

Return the chicken to the pan and nestle it into the sauce. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer gently for about 30 minutes until the chicken becomes tender and fully cooked.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:220:"

Sprinkle chopped parsley and cilantro over the finished dish. Taste the sauce and adjust seasoning if needed, keeping in mind the olives and preserved lemon already add salt. Let rest a few minutes before serving.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Only the peel of preserved lemons is typically used in cooking since the pulp can be quite salty. Simmer the chicken gently so the spices and citrus flavors fully develop. This dish often tastes even better the next day as the flavors deepen. Serve family-style with couscous or crusty bread to soak up the sauce.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Cozy Colcannon with Bacon and Cabbage
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This cozy colcannon is a comforting Irish-inspired side dish made with creamy Yukon Gold potatoes, crispy bacon, tender cabbage, sweet onion, and a touch of garlic. Finished with melted butter and optional scallions, it is hearty, savory, and perfect alongside corned beef or any cozy dinner.
item.category: diced scallions, for serving if desired
Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:11:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"4";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:13:"chicken stock";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:494;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"2 1/2";s:4:"unit";s:6:"pounds";s:4:"name";s:54:"Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:495;s:2:"id";i:496;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"6";s:4:"unit";s:6:"slices";s:4:"name";s:15:"thick-cut bacon";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:83;s:2:"id";i:497;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"head";s:4:"name";s:16:"cabbage, chopped";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:498;s:2:"id";i:499;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:5:"large";s:4:"name";s:21:"yellow onion, chopped";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:302;s:2:"id";i:500;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:6:"cloves";s:4:"name";s:14:"garlic, minced";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:76;s:2:"id";i:77;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"1 1/2";s:4:"unit";s:9:"teaspoons";s:4:"name";s:11:"kosher salt";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:170;s:2:"id";i:255;}i:7;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:12:"black pepper";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:367;}i:8;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:4:"milk";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:501;}i:9;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:23:"unsalted butter, melted";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:236;}i:10;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:39:"diced scallions, for serving if desired";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:502;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:185:"

Add the potatoes to a large saucepan or Dutch oven and pour in the chicken stock. Bring to a boil, then cover and cook until the potatoes are fork-tender, about 15 to 20 minutes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:170:"

While the potatoes are cooking, fry the bacon in a large skillet until crisp. Transfer it to a paper towel-lined plate to cool, then crumble into bite-size pieces.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:194:"

Leave the bacon drippings in the skillet and add the cabbage, onion, and garlic. Sprinkle in the salt and pepper, then cook until the vegetables are soft and tender, about 5 to 7 minutes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:222:"

Drain the potatoes and mash them well. Stir in the milk and mix until as smooth or fluffy as you like. Fold in the cabbage-onion mixture and the crumbled bacon. Taste and add a little more salt and pepper if needed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:140:"

Spoon the colcannon into a serving bowl, drizzle the melted butter over the top, and scatter on diced scallions if using. Serve warm.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Yukon Gold potatoes give this colcannon a naturally buttery, creamy texture, though russets can be used for a fluffier mash. Kale can be substituted for cabbage; just remove the thick stems, chop it, and sauté until tender. This recipe can be made ahead and refrigerated for up to 24 hours, then reheated covered at 350°F for about 30 minutes. It also freezes well for up to 3 months once cooled. To avoid gummy potatoes, mash and mix gently just until combined.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These wholesome breakfast cookies are soft, hearty, and filled with oats, banana, peanut butter, seeds, dried cranberries, and dark chocolate chips. They are practical for breakfast, snack time, or packing into a lunchbox, and they stay soft for days which makes them ideal for meal prep.
item.category: mixed seeds, such as pumpkin and sunflower seeds
