a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:79:"

Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:130:"

In a large bowl, mash the bananas well. Stir in the peanut butter, honey, eggs, and vanilla until smooth and well combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:105:"

Add the oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Stir gently until the mixture is evenly combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:131:"

Add the chocolate chips, dried cranberries, and mixed seeds. Fold just until everything is distributed throughout the dough.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:174:"

Scoop the dough onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing the cookies slightly apart. Bake for 14 to 16 minutes, until the cookies are set and the tops look lightly dry.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:121:"

Let the cookies rest on the baking sheet for about 5 minutes, then move them to a rack or plate to finish cooling.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:65:"

Serve warm or once cooled, and store for later if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use ripe bananas for the best sweetness and moisture. Do not overmix the dough or the cookies may become dense. Slightly underbake for a softer texture. Wet your hands lightly if you want to shape the cookies before baking, and rotate the baking sheet halfway through for even results. Store cooled cookies in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days, in the refrigerator for up to 1 week, or freeze for up to 2 months. To make them vegan, use flax eggs instead of eggs and maple syrup instead of honey. Yield and nutrition are estimated for 12 cookies.

a:3:{s:4:"type";s:3:"bad";s:7:"message";s:63:"There are no ratings for your recipe.
Required fields: Name";s:8:"priority";i:5;}

item.title: Irish Potato Cakes
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These Irish potato cakes are golden and crisp on the outside, soft and fluffy in the middle, and made with simple pantry staples. They are an easy, comforting way to use leftover mashed potatoes for breakfast, a snack, or a hearty side dish.
item.category: all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:5:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:412;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:17:"large mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:233;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:25:"measuring cups and spoons";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:490;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"large skillet";s:5:"notes";s:43:"nonstick or cast-iron works especially well";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:234;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:7:"spatula";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:491;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:23:"paper towel-lined plate";s:5:"notes";s:25:"for draining after frying";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:8:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:15:"mashed potatoes";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:520;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:41:"all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:521;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:13:"baking powder";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:159;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:4:"salt";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:36;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:12:"black pepper";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:367;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:31:"chopped green onions (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:522;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:26:"shredded cheese (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:523;}i:7;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:18:"butter, for frying";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:524;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:221:"

In a large bowl, stir together the mashed potatoes, flour, baking powder, salt, and black pepper until a soft dough forms. It should feel easy to handle, not wet and sticky. Add a light sprinkle of flour if needed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:82:"

If using the green onions or shredded cheese, fold them into the dough now.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:143:"

Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Divide it into 8 equal portions and shape each one into a patty about 1/2 inch thick.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:93:"

Dust each patty lightly with flour to help prevent sticking and create a crisp finish.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:138:"

Heat a large skillet over medium heat and melt the butter. Once bubbling, add the potato cakes in batches without crowding the pan.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:99:"

Cook for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until the cakes are golden brown and crisp on the outside.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:106:"

Transfer the cooked cakes to a paper towel-lined plate to drain any excess butter, then serve warm.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Leftover mashed potatoes work beautifully here. If the dough feels too sticky, add a little extra flour, one spoonful at a time, until soft and workable. Keep the skillet at medium heat so the cakes crisp without burning. Do not skip the light flour coating, as it helps create a crisp finish. Optional green onions and cheese add extra flavor, but the cakes are also delicious plain.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Air Fryer Stuffed Chicken Breast
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This air fryer stuffed chicken breast is an easy cordon bleu-style dinner with juicy chicken, savory ham, melty Swiss or Gruyère cheese, and a crisp golden breadcrumb coating. It is a simple weeknight-friendly recipe that feels special without a lot of mess.
item.category: salt and black pepper, to taste

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:10:{i:0;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:34:"boneless, skinless chicken breasts";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:331;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"2–4";s:4:"unit";s:6:"slices";s:4:"name";s:8:"deli ham";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:83;s:2:"id";i:532;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:6:"slices";s:4:"name";s:24:"Swiss or Gruyère cheese";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:83;s:2:"id";i:533;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:17:"panko breadcrumbs";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:534;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:17:"all-purpose flour";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:33;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:5:"large";s:4:"name";s:11:"egg, beaten";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:302;s:2:"id";i:535;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:13:"garlic powder";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:332;}i:7;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:7:"paprika";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:308;}i:8;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:31:"salt and black pepper, to taste";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:536;}i:9;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:15:"olive oil spray";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:537;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:197:"

Place the chicken breasts on a cutting board and carefully cut a pocket into the thickest part of each one. Season the inside and outside with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:150:"

Fold a slice of cheese inside a slice of ham, then tuck that bundle neatly into each chicken pocket. Secure the opening with 1 or 2 toothpicks.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:206:"

Set out three shallow bowls: one with flour, one with the beaten egg, and one with the panko breadcrumbs. Coat each stuffed chicken breast first in flour, then in egg, and finally in the breadcrumbs.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:276:"

Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C). Lightly spray the basket with olive oil spray. Place the chicken in the basket, spray the tops lightly with oil, and cook for 15 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and the internal temperature reaches 165°F.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:85:"

Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before removing the toothpicks and slicing.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Pat the chicken dry before breading so the coating sticks better. Do not overcrowd the air fryer basket or the chicken may not crisp properly. A light spray of oil over the breadcrumbs helps create a deeper golden color. Check doneness with a meat thermometer in the thickest part and cook until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days and reheated in the air fryer at 350°F for 4 to 5 minutes.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Crispy Cheesy Grilled Cheese Burrito
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This crispy, cheesy grilled cheese burrito is inspired by the famous taco-shop favorite but even better homemade. Filled with seasoned beef, fluffy rice, creamy sauces, and melted cheese, then grilled onto a layer of cheese for a golden crispy crust, it’s the ultimate comforting weeknight dinner ready in about 30 minutes.
item.category: butter or oil for the skillet
shredded cheese for grilling (cheddar or Mexican blend)

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:11:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:2:"lb";s:4:"name";s:11:"ground beef";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:300;s:2:"id";i:199;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:6:"packet";s:4:"name";s:14:"taco seasoning";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:544;s:2:"id";i:202;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:17:"cooked white rice";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:545;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:10:"sour cream";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:546;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:18:"nacho cheese sauce";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:547;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:14:"chipotle sauce";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:548;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:23:"shredded cheddar cheese";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:204;}i:7;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:26:"shredded mozzarella cheese";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:549;}i:8;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"4";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:21:"large flour tortillas";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:550;}i:9;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:55:"shredded cheese for grilling (cheddar or Mexican blend)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:551;}i:10;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:29:"butter or oil for the skillet";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:552;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:247:"

Place a skillet over medium heat and cook the ground beef until browned and crumbly, about 8–10 minutes. Drain excess grease. Add taco seasoning and about 1/4 cup water, then simmer for 5 minutes until the meat is well coated with spices.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:165:"

Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet for about 20 seconds per side or microwave them wrapped in a damp paper towel for 20–30 seconds until soft and flexible.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:256:"

Lay each tortilla flat and layer about 1/4 cup cooked rice, 2–3 tablespoons seasoned beef, 1 tablespoon nacho cheese sauce, a drizzle of chipotle sauce, 1 tablespoon sour cream, and a small handful of shredded cheddar and mozzarella in the center.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:173:"

Fold the sides of the tortilla inward and roll from the bottom up, keeping the filling snug inside to form a tightly wrapped burrito. Repeat with remaining tortillas.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:289:"

Heat a clean skillet over medium heat and sprinkle about 2 tablespoons shredded cheese directly into the pan. Place the burrito seam-side down onto the cheese and cook for 3–4 minutes until the cheese melts and forms a golden crispy crust. Flip and cook the other side if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Warm tortillas before rolling to prevent cracking. Shred your own cheese for a smoother melt and crispier crust. Day-old rice works best because it stays fluffy. Cook over medium heat so the cheese melts and crisps without burning. You can easily swap the beef for shredded chicken, beans, or plant-based crumbles.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Quick & Easy Homemade Butter Chicken
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This quick and easy homemade butter chicken delivers creamy, comforting restaurant-style flavor in about 45 minutes. Tender chicken pieces simmer in a rich tomato, butter, and cream sauce infused with warm spices like garam masala, cumin, and coriander. Perfect for cozy weeknight dinners, it pairs beautifully with fluffy basmati rice or warm naan.
item.category: boneless chicken thighs or breasts, cut into chunks

powder";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:562;}i:15;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:8:"turmeric";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:563;}i:16;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1.5";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:12:"tomato puree";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:566;}i:17;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:11:"heavy cream";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:139;}i:18;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:16:"sugar (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:567;}i:19;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"salt to garnish)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:568;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:203:"

In a bowl, combine yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric, cumin, and salt. Add the chicken pieces and toss until well coated. Cover and marinate for at least 30 minutes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:207:"

Heat a large skillet over medium heat with a little oil. Cook the marinated chicken for 6–8 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and mostly cooked through. Transfer to a plate and set aside.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:215:"

In the same skillet, melt the butter with the oil. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:134:"

Add garam masala, coriander, chili powder, and turmeric. Stir and toast the spices for about 30 seconds to release their aroma.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:151:"

Pour in the tomato puree and stir well. Let the sauce simmer for 5–7 minutes until slightly thickened. Add sugar if needed to balance acidity.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:183:"

Return the cooked chicken to the skillet and stir into the sauce. Pour in the heavy cream and simmer gently for 5–10 minutes until the sauce becomes smooth, rich, and creamy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:109:"

Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the finished dish and serve warm with basmati rice, naan, or flatbread.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For extra juicy chicken, use boneless chicken thighs instead of breast. Adjust the chili powder to control the heat level. Butter chicken often tastes even better the next day as the spices continue to develop. If the sauce becomes too thick during reheating, add a splash of cream or water to loosen it.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Sweet Hawaiian Crockpot Chicken
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A simple slow-cooker dinner made with tender chicken, sweet pineapple, and sticky barbecue sauce. This easy Hawaiian-inspired recipe requires just a few ingredients and minimal prep, letting the crockpot do all the work while creating a rich, glossy sauce perfect for serving over rice.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:7:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:2:"lb";s:4:"name";s:53:"bone-in, skin-on chicken breasts (about 4–6 pieces)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:300;s:2:"id";i:576;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:2:"16";s:4:"unit";s:2:"oz";s:4:"name";s:14:"barbecue sauce";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:56;s:2:"id";i:577;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"8";s:4:"unit";s:2:"oz";s:4:"name";s:45:"pineapple chunks, drained (reserve the juice)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:56;s:2:"id";i:578;}i:3;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:15:"salt (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:579;}i:4;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:23:"black pepper (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:580;}i:5;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:35:"green onions for garnish (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:581;}i:6;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:35:"sesame seeds for garnish (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:582;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:143:"

Drain the pineapple chunks and reserve the juice for later. If the pineapple pieces are large, chop them into smaller bite-sized chunks.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:130:"

In a medium bowl, stir together the barbecue sauce and pineapple chunks until the mixture looks glossy and evenly combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:148:"

Pour a small amount of the sauce mixture into the bottom of the slow cooker to prevent sticking. Lay the chicken breasts on top of the sauce.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:185:"

Pour the remaining barbecue-pineapple sauce evenly over the chicken so each piece is coated. Add a splash of the reserved pineapple juice if you want a sweeter or saucier finish.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:175:"

Cover and cook in the slow cooker on LOW for 6–8 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours until the chicken is very tender and reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:104:"

Serve the chicken breasts whole or shred them gently with two forks for a pulled-chicken texture.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:188:"

Spoon the sweet pineapple barbecue sauce from the slow cooker over the chicken and garnish with green onions or sesame seeds if desired. Serve over rice or with your favorite sides.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Bone-in chicken helps keep the meat juicy during long slow cooking. Avoid opening the slow cooker frequently since heat escapes and increases cooking time. For thicker sauce, remove the lid during the last 20 minutes or stir in a small cornstarch slurry. Let the chicken rest in the sauce for 5–10 minutes before serving so it absorbs extra flavor.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Sizzling Chinese Pepper Steak with Onions
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This cozy Chinese Pepper Steak with Onions brings takeout-style flavor right to your kitchen. Tender strips of beef are stir-fried with sweet caramelized onions and coated in a rich, glossy sauce made with soy sauce, hoisin, garlic, and ginger. It’s a quick and comforting dinner that’s perfect for busy weeknights and delicious served over steamed rice or noodles.
item.category: sliced green onions or sesame seeds for garnish (optional)
steamed rice or noodles for serving (optional)

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:221:"

In a bowl, mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, grated ginger, minced garlic, and sesame oil. Add the sliced beef and toss until well coated. Let the beef marinate for 10–15 minutes while preparing the other ingredients.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:262:"

Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook for 5–6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly caramelized. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper, then remove from the pan and set aside.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:205:"

Using the same skillet, heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil over high heat. Add the marinated beef in a single layer and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring quickly, until browned and just cooked through.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:106:"

In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, and cornstarch until smooth.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:132:"

Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet with the beef. Stir constantly as the sauce heats and thickens, about 1–2 minutes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:209:"

Return the cooked onions to the pan and toss everything together until evenly coated in the glossy sauce. Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles and garnish with green onions or sesame seeds if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Slice the beef thinly against the grain for the most tender texture. Cook the beef over high heat and avoid overcrowding the pan to achieve a proper sear. For extra spice, add chili flakes or a drizzle of chili oil. You can substitute chicken, shrimp, tofu, or mushrooms for the beef. Store leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.

item.title: Easy Lemon Brownies
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These easy lemon brownies are soft, buttery, and packed with bright citrus flavor. Made with simple pantry ingredients and topped with a sweet-tart lemon glaze, they bake into tender, fudgy bars that are perfect for spring gatherings, afternoon coffee, or whenever you want a cheerful homemade dessert.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:7:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:606;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:20:"9x13 inch baking pan";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:153;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:15:"parchment paper";s:5:"notes";s:41:"optional but helps remove brownies easily";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:150;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:12:"mixing bowls";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:364;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:5:"whisk";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:234;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:7:"spatula";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:5;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:607;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"citrus zester";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:6;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:608;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"citrus juicer";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:11:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"1 1/2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:17:"all-purpose flour";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:33;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"1 1/2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:16:"granulated sugar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:45;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:4:"salt";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:36;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:25:"unsalted butter, softened";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:267;}i:4;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"4";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:28:"large eggs, room temperature";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:238;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:10:"lemon zest";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:609;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/3";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:17:"fresh lemon juice";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:434;}i:7;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:15:"vanilla extract";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:59;}i:8;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:14:"powdered sugar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:58;}i:9;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"2-3";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:29:"fresh lemon juice (for glaze)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:610;}i:10;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:22:"lemon zest (for glaze)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:611;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:8:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:160:"

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 9×13 inch baking pan with parchment paper or lightly grease it so the brownies release easily after baking.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:107:"

In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, granulated sugar, and salt until evenly combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:143:"

In a separate bowl, beat together the softened butter, eggs, lemon zest, fresh lemon juice, and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:142:"

Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture. Stir gently until just combined, avoiding overmixing so the brownies stay tender.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:189:"

Spread the batter evenly into the prepared baking pan. Bake for about 25 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out mostly clean and the edges are lightly golden.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:83:"

Allow the brownies to cool completely in the pan before preparing the glaze.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:119:"

In a small bowl, whisk together the powdered sugar, fresh lemon juice, and lemon zest until smooth and pourable.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:7;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 8";s:4:"text";s:155:"

Pour the glaze over the cooled brownies and spread it evenly across the top. Let it set for 10–15 minutes before slicing into squares and serving.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use freshly squeezed lemon juice and zest for the best flavor. Avoid overbaking so the brownies stay soft and fudgy in the center. Let the brownies cool completely before adding the glaze so it sets into a glossy sweet-tart layer. For extra lemon flavor, add additional zest to the batter or glaze.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Cozy Banana Oatmeal Bars
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These cozy banana oatmeal bars are soft, hearty, and naturally sweetened with ripe bananas and maple syrup. Made in just one bowl with rolled oats, nut butter, and chocolate chips, they’re perfect for breakfast, snacks, or meal prep.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:141:"

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 9×9 inch baking pan with parchment paper so the bars can be easily removed after baking.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:101:"

In a large mixing bowl, mash the ripe bananas until mostly smooth. A few small lumps are fine.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:128:"

Add the nut butter, rolled oats, cinnamon, vanilla extract, maple syrup, chocolate chips, and salt to the mashed bananas.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:79:"

Mix everything together until fully combined. The mixture will be thick.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:126:"

Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking pan and press it into an even layer using a spatula or the back of a spoon.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:167:"

Bake for 18–20 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the bars look set. Allow the bars to cool completely in the pan before slicing into 16 squares.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use very ripe bananas for the best flavor and natural sweetness. Press the mixture firmly into the pan so the bars hold together well. Let the bars cool completely before slicing to help them set properly. You can customize them with chopped nuts, dried fruit, seeds, or dark chocolate chunks.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Green Velvet Cake
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This festive Green Velvet Cake is the cheerful cousin of classic red velvet. It has the same soft, tender crumb and hint of cocoa flavor, paired with rich tangy cream cheese frosting and a bright green color perfect for St. Patrick’s Day, spring parties, or fun birthday cupcakes.
item.category: milk, as needed for frosting consistency

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease cake pans or line a cupcake pan with paper liners.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:166:"

In a medium bowl lightly whisk the eggs. Add vegetable oil, buttermilk, vinegar, and vanilla extract. Whisk until smooth, then stir in the green food coloring.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:118:"

In a large mixing bowl combine the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, salt, and baking soda. Whisk until evenly mixed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:140:"

Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and mix on medium speed for 1–2 minutes until the batter is smooth and well combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:269:"

Pour the batter into prepared pans. Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Approximate baking times: 22 minutes for cake layers, 16 minutes for standard cupcakes, or 13 minutes for mini cupcakes. Let cakes cool completely before frosting.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:212:"

In a mixing bowl beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth. Add the vanilla extract and gradually mix in the powdered sugar. Add milk a little at a time until the frosting becomes thick but spreadable.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:180:"

Spread or pipe the cream cheese frosting over the cooled cake or cupcakes. Decorate with sprinkles, green sanding sugar, gold sugar crystals, or festive toppings if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Do not skip the vinegar—it reacts with the baking soda to create the classic velvet texture. Use room-temperature eggs and buttermilk for smoother batter. Mix just until combined to keep the cake light and fluffy. Gel food coloring works best for a vibrant color without adding extra liquid.

item.title: Traditional Irish Potato Pie
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A comforting and rustic Irish potato pie made with layers of thinly sliced russet potatoes, sharp cheddar cheese, cream, and a flaky pie crust. Baked until golden and bubbly, this hearty dish is simple, cozy, and perfect for family dinners or gatherings.
item.category: russet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:10:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:110:"

Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly grease a 9-inch pie dish so the crust doesn’t stick.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:113:"

Roll out the pie crust and gently press it into the prepared dish. Trim any excess dough around the edges.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:127:"

Layer half of the thinly sliced potatoes in the crust. Sprinkle with half of the salt, pepper, thyme, and garlic powder.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:77:"

Sprinkle half of the shredded cheddar cheese evenly over the potatoes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:114:"

Add the remaining sliced potatoes and sprinkle with the rest of the salt, pepper, thyme, and garlic powder.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:54:"

Top with the remaining shredded cheddar cheese.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:107:"

Slowly drizzle the heavy cream over the layered potatoes and brush the melted butter across the top.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:7;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 8";s:4:"text";s:92:"

Brush the edges of the crust with the beaten egg to help it turn golden while baking.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:8;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 9";s:4:"text";s:72:"

Cover the pie loosely with aluminum foil and bake for 40 minutes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:9;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:7:"Step 10";s:4:"text";s:205:"

Remove the foil and bake for another 20–25 minutes until the crust is golden and the filling is bubbling. Let the pie rest for 10 minutes before slicing, then garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Slice the potatoes thinly so they cook evenly and become tender in the oven. Sharp Irish cheddar adds the best flavor, but any strong cheddar works well. Let the pie rest for about 10 minutes before slicing so the layers hold together. You can also add sautéed onions, bacon bits, or cooked sausage between layers for extra flavor.

item.title: Triple Layer Mint Oreo Brownies
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A rich, fudgy brownie dessert made with three delicious layers: a dense chocolate brownie base filled with chopped Mint Oreos, a smooth peppermint cream layer, and a glossy chocolate topping. The combination of deep chocolate and refreshing mint makes these brownies an irresistible treat for holidays, parties, or any time you crave a decadent dessert.

chips";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:660;}i:14;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:6:"butter";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:79;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:168:"

Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 9 x 13 inch baking pan with parchment paper or foil and lightly grease it to make removing the brownies easier later.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:301:"

In a large bowl combine the melted butter, granulated sugar, and cocoa powder. Stir until smooth and glossy. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition, then stir in the vanilla extract. Gently mix in the flour and salt until just combined, then fold in the chopped Mint Oreos.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:213:"

Spread the brownie batter evenly into the prepared pan. Bake for about 25 minutes or until the center is just set and still slightly soft. Allow the brownies to cool completely before adding the next layer.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:317:"

In a medium bowl beat the softened butter and powdered sugar until smooth. Add the milk and peppermint extract and continue mixing until creamy. Stir in a small drop of green food coloring if desired. Spread the mint mixture evenly over the cooled brownie layer and refrigerate for about 30 minutes until firm.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:219:"

In a microwave-safe bowl melt the chocolate chips and butter together in short bursts, stirring every 20 seconds until smooth. Pour the melted chocolate over the mint layer and spread gently to cover the surface.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:234:"

Return the pan to the refrigerator for about 1 hour until the chocolate topping sets. Once fully chilled, lift the brownies from the pan and slice into squares using a sharp knife, wiping the blade between cuts for neat layers.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For the best texture, allow the brownies to cool completely before adding the mint layer so it doesn’t melt. Chill the brownies before slicing to achieve clean, beautiful layers. Use high-quality cocoa powder for deeper chocolate flavor. If Mint Oreos are unavailable, regular Oreos can be used and you can slightly increase the peppermint extract for extra mint flavor.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Shamrock Homemade Gummies with Jello
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These bright green shamrock homemade gummies are a fun and chewy St. Patrick’s Day treat made with applesauce, lime Jello, sugar, and gelatin. Easy to prepare with just a saucepan and a baking dish, the mixture sets into a sliceable candy that can be cut into festive shapes and rolled in sugar for a classic sweet finish.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:7:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:441;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:15:"medium saucepan";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:665;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:32:"wooden spoon or silicone spatula";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:666;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:19:"13 × 9 baking dish";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:153;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:15:"parchment paper";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:667;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:37:"cookie cutter (shamrock or any shape)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:5;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:507;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:12:"baking sheet";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:6;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:99;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"cutting board";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:8:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:100:"

Line a 13×9 baking dish with parchment paper so the candy can be easily lifted out once set.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:136:"

In a medium saucepan, combine the applesauce, granulated sugar, lime Jello, and unflavored gelatin. Stir well until evenly mixed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:113:"

Place the saucepan over medium to medium-high heat and stir continuously as the ingredients melt together.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:137:"

Once the mixture reaches a boil, allow it to gently boil for about 1 minute while stirring until smooth, glossy, and bright green.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:86:"

Carefully pour the hot mixture into the prepared baking dish and spread evenly.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:111:"

Place the dish in the refrigerator and chill for about 2 hours or until the candy is fully set and firm.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:127:"

Lift the gummy slab out using the parchment paper, place it on a cutting board, and lightly sprinkle sugar over the top.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:7;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 8";s:4:"text";s:266:"

Use a shamrock cookie cutter (or any shape you like) to cut gummies. Dip the cutter in sugar between cuts to prevent sticking. Roll each gummy lightly in sugar and place them on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Let them rest for 30–60 minutes before serving.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Dip the cookie cutter in sugar between cuts to prevent sticking. Silicone candy molds can also be used instead of cutting shapes. For sour gummies, mix 1/2 teaspoon citric acid into the sugar coating. Store gummies in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks, placing parchment between layers to prevent sticking. Freezing is not recommended as gelatin candy may become watery after thawing.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Fresh & Frosty Watermelon Slushie
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This fresh and frosty watermelon slushie is a simple summer drink that tastes like sunshine in a glass. Made with frozen watermelon, lime juice, and a hint of maple syrup, it blends into a naturally sweet, icy treat that’s refreshing, light, and perfect for hot days.
item.category: fresh mint leaves or basil (loosely packed, optional)
seedless watermelon cubes, frozen for at least 24 hours

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:5:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:2:"10";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:55:"seedless watermelon cubes, frozen for at least 24 hours";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:683;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"2–4";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:29:"maple syrup (adjust to taste)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:684;}i:2;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:21:"juice of 1 large lime";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:685;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:53:"fresh mint leaves or basil (loosely packed, optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:686;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"1 1/2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:14:"filtered water";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:687;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:169:"

Take the frozen watermelon cubes out of the freezer and let them sit at room temperature for about 5–10 minutes so they soften slightly and are easier to blend.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:117:"

Add the watermelon, 2 tablespoons maple syrup, lime juice, mint (or basil), and water to a high-speed blender.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:87:"

Pulse the blender a few times first to break the watermelon into smaller chunks.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:83:"

Blend until the mixture becomes smooth and icy with a thick slushie texture.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:165:"

Taste the slushie and add more maple syrup if you’d like it sweeter. If the mixture is thicker than you prefer, add a small splash of water and blend again.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:87:"

Pour into glasses and serve immediately while the slushie is icy and refreshing.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use very ripe watermelon for the sweetest flavor. Freeze the watermelon cubes in a single layer so they blend easily later. If the slushie is too thick, add a splash of water and blend again. If it’s too thin, add more frozen watermelon. This drink is best served immediately while icy and fresh, but leftovers can be frozen and re-blended or turned into popsicles.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Fluffy Pancake Balls
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These fluffy pancake balls are soft, buttery mini pancake bites baked in a mini muffin pan instead of cooked on a skillet. They’re quick to make, ready in under 20 minutes, and perfect for dipping in maple syrup, yogurt, or honey. Great for busy mornings, brunch boards, and meal prep since they freeze and reheat beautifully.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:117:"

Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly grease a mini muffin pan so the pancake balls release easily.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:111:"

In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt until evenly combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:102:"

In another bowl, whisk together the milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla extract until smooth.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:135:"

Pour the wet ingredients into the bowl with the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined. A few small lumps are fine.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:90:"

Spoon the batter into the mini muffin cups, filling each about three-quarters full.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:110:"

If desired, sprinkle mix-ins such as blueberries or mini chocolate chips into the batter before baking.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:196:"

Bake for 10–12 minutes until the tops are lightly golden and spring back when touched. Let cool briefly, then remove from the pan and serve warm with syrup, honey, yogurt, or fresh fruit.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Do not overmix the batter or the pancake bites can become dense. Grease the mini muffin pan well so the pancake balls release easily. You can customize them with mix-ins like mini chocolate chips, blueberries, diced strawberries, cinnamon sugar, bacon bits, or shredded cheese for a savory version. These freeze well for up to 2 months and can be reheated in the microwave, oven, or air fryer.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Irresistible Shamrock Swirl Pie
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A cool and creamy no-bake mint pie with beautiful green shamrock swirls and a crunchy chocolate cookie crust. This refreshing dessert is light, fluffy, and perfect for St. Patrick’s Day or any time you crave a sweet minty treat.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:5:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:639;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:15:"9-inch pie dish";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:150;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:12:"mixing bowls";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:701;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:28:"electric mixer or hand mixer";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:702;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:14:"rubber spatula";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:703;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:37:"butter knife or skewer (for swirling)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:319:"

Crush the chocolate sandwich cookies using a food processor or by placing them in a sealed bag and crushing with a rolling pin. Mix the crumbs with melted butter until evenly coated. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom and slightly up the sides of a 9-inch pie dish. Refrigerate while preparing the filling.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:171:"

In a mixing bowl, beat the softened cream cheese until smooth and creamy. Add powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and mint extract. Mix until fully combined and silky.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:99:"

Stir the melted white chocolate into the cream cheese mixture until well blended and creamy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:154:"

In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until soft peaks form. Gently fold the whipped cream into the cream cheese mixture until light and fluffy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:266:"

Divide the filling into two bowls. Add green food coloring to one portion and mix until evenly colored. Spoon alternating dollops of white and green filling into the chilled crust, then gently swirl with a knife or skewer to create a marbled shamrock pattern.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:193:"

Refrigerate the pie for at least 4 hours or until fully set. Before serving, garnish with whipped cream, chocolate shavings, sprinkles, or fresh mint if desired. Slice and serve chilled.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For the smoothest filling, let the cream cheese soften at room temperature for about 30 minutes before mixing. Avoid over-swirling the filling so the green and white layers stay distinct. This pie sets best when chilled overnight. Store covered in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 2 months, thawing overnight in the fridge before serving.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Minty Ice Cream Shamrocks
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These Minty Ice Cream Shamrocks are a festive St. Patrick’s Day dessert made with soft chocolate cookies sandwiched around creamy mint chocolate chip ice cream. The playful shamrock shape and refreshing chocolate-mint flavor make them perfect for holiday dessert tables, family gatherings, or a fun baking project with kids.
item.category: mint chocolate chip ice cream cookies
mint chocolate chip ice cream, softened

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:8:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:150;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:12:"mixing bowls";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:714;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:26:"hand mixer or wooden spoon";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:26;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:11:"Rolling Pin";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:715;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:29:"3-inch shamrock cookie cutter";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:716;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"baking sheets";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:5;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:153;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:15:"parchment paper";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:6;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:717;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:17:"wire cooling rack";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:7;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:64;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:12:"plastic wrap";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:0;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:167:"

In a small mixing bowl, cream together the softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the egg, milk, and vanilla extract and mix until well combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:183:"

In another bowl, whisk together the flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture and mix just until a soft dough forms.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:2;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:157:"

Divide the dough into two portions and flatten each into a disc. Wrap them in plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 1 hour until firm enough to roll.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:3;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:255:"

Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Roll the chilled dough on a lightly floured surface to about 1/8–1/4 inch thickness. Cut out shapes using a floured 3-inch shamrock cookie cutter and place them 2 inches apart on parchment-lined baking sheets.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:4;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:158:"

Bake for 7–10 minutes or until the cookies are set. Let them cool on the baking sheet for 2 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:5;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:263:"

Spread about 1/4 to 1/3 cup softened mint chocolate chip ice cream on the bottom of one cookie and top with another to form a sandwich. Repeat with remaining cookies, wrap each sandwich in plastic wrap, and freeze until firm for several hours or overnight.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Chill the dough well before rolling so the cookies hold their shape. If the dough becomes sticky while rolling, refrigerate it again for about 10 minutes. Use slightly softened ice cream so it spreads easily between cookies. After assembling the sandwiches, wrap them individually and freeze immediately so the ice cream keeps its shape. For a festive finish, roll the ice cream edges in mini chocolate chips, green sprinkles, or crushed chocolate sandwich cookies.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Cinnamon Sugar Air Fryer Banana Chips
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These cinnamon sugar air fryer banana chips are a simple homemade snack made with just a few pantry ingredients. Firm banana slices are lightly coated with oil and cinnamon, then air fried until golden and crisp. Naturally sweet, crunchy, and perfect for topping yogurt, adding to trail mix, or enjoying as a quick healthy snack.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:6:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:529;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:9:"air fryer";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:152;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:11:"sharp knife";s:5:"notes";s:35:"or mandoline slicer for even slices";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:99;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"cutting board";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:724;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:17:"small mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:412;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:17:"large mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:5;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:725;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:25:"spoon or silicone spatula";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:4:{i:0;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:34:"bananas (green or slightly yellow)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:726;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:24:"avocado oil or olive oil";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:727;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:4:"0.25";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:15:"ground cinnamon";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:52;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"1–2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:44:"coconut sugar or granulated sugar (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:728;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:8:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:116:"

Preheat the air fryer to 300°F (150°C) for about 5 minutes so the banana slices start crisping immediately.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:159:"

Peel the bananas and slice them into ¼-inch rounds using a sharp knife or mandoline slicer. Try to keep the slices even so they cook at the same speed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:85:"

In a small bowl, mix together the oil and ground cinnamon until well combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:143:"

Place the banana slices in a large bowl. Drizzle the cinnamon oil mixture over them and gently toss until all slices are lightly coated.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:132:"

Arrange the banana slices in the air fryer basket in a single layer. Avoid overlapping so the hot air can circulate properly.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:118:"

Air fry at 300°F (150°C) for 25–28 minutes. Flip the slices halfway through cooking and check for browning.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:113:"

During the last few minutes, watch the chips closely to prevent burning as thinner slices may cook faster.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:7;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 8";s:4:"text";s:145:"

Remove the banana chips from the air fryer and let them cool for 5–10 minutes. They will crisp up further as they cool. Serve and enjoy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For the best texture, use bananas that are slightly green or just yellow, not ripe. Ripe bananas contain more sugar and may soften or burn during cooking. Let the chips cool for 5–10 minutes after air frying, as they crisp up more while resting. If the chips lose their crunch after storage, reheat them in the air fryer at 300°F for 2–3 minutes and cool again to restore crispiness.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Crispy Bang Bang Salmon Bites
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: Crispy Bang Bang Salmon Bites are golden, crunchy salmon cubes served over fluffy rice with fresh vegetables and drizzled with a creamy sweet-and-spicy bang bang sauce. This easy 30-minute recipe creates a restaurant-style bowl that’s perfect for weeknight dinners, meal prep, or healthy comfort food.
item.category: fresh salmon, skinless and cut into bite-sized cubes

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:140:"

Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) or preheat the air fryer to 390°F (200°C) to ensure the salmon cooks evenly and crisps nicely.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:158:"

Place the salmon cubes in a bowl and season with garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Toss gently until all pieces are evenly coated.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:160:"

Press each piece of salmon into the panko breadcrumbs until well coated. Lightly spray or drizzle with olive oil to help the coating crisp while cooking.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:247:"

Cook the salmon. Oven method: place the salmon on a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake for 12–14 minutes until golden and crispy. Air fryer method: arrange salmon in a single layer and cook for 8–10 minutes, flipping halfway through.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:160:"

In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, sweet chili sauce, sriracha, honey, and lime juice until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust spice if needed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:253:"

Assemble the bowls by adding warm jasmine rice to serving bowls. Top with shredded cabbage, carrots, avocado slices, and crispy salmon bites. Drizzle generously with bang bang sauce and garnish with green onions, sesame seeds, and fresh cilantro.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Pat the salmon dry before seasoning so the coating sticks better. Cut evenly sized cubes for even cooking. Avoid overcrowding the pan or air fryer to keep the salmon crispy. The bang bang sauce can be made ahead and stored in the refrigerator for a few hours to deepen the flavor. For a low-carb option, use cauliflower rice instead of jasmine rice.

item.title: Sticky Garlic Chicken Noodles
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These sticky garlic chicken noodles are a quick, takeout-inspired dinner made with tender chicken, chewy noodles, and a glossy sweet-savory garlic sauce that clings to every bite.
item.category: chicken breast or thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:7:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:588;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:20:"large skillet or wok";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:752;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:10:"medium pot";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:429;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:8:"colander";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:248;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:11:"mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:680;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:23:"knife and cutting board";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:5;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:233;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:25:"measuring cups and spoons";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:6;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:443;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:23:"wooden spoon or spatula";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:8:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:250:"

Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the noodles according to the package directions until just al dente. Drain well, then toss with a tiny drizzle of oil so they do not stick together while you finish everything else. Set aside.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:119:"

Place the chicken pieces in a bowl and sprinkle over the cornstarch. Toss until every piece has a light coating.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:239:"

Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in a single layer and cook until golden, turning as needed, until fully cooked and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Transfer to a plate.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:116:"

In the same skillet, add the minced garlic and grated ginger. Stir for 30 to 60 seconds, just until fragrant.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:263:"

Pour in the soy sauce, honey, and red chili flakes if using. Stir as the sauce bubbles for 2 to 3 minutes, until slightly thickened and glossy. For a thicker sauce, stir 1 to 2 teaspoons extra cornstarch with the same amount of water and add it to the pan.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:105:"

Return the cooked chicken to the skillet and toss until every piece is coated in the sticky sauce.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:121:"

Add the cooked noodles and toss everything together for about 1 minute, until warmed through and shiny with sauce.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:7;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 8";s:4:"text";s:78:"

Scatter the green onions and sesame seeds over the top, then serve hot.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Chicken thighs will give a juicier result, while chicken breast stays lean and works beautifully too. Do not skip the cornstarch, as it helps the chicken brown and gives the sauce its glossy finish. This recipe cooks quickly, so have the garlic, ginger, and sauce ingredients ready before heating the pan. For leftovers, store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days, ideally keeping the noodles separate from the chicken and sauce for the best texture. The chicken and sauce can also be frozen for up to 2 months; cook fresh noodles when ready to serve.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Creamy Mexican Macaroni Salad
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This creamy Mexican macaroni salad is a bright and flavorful twist on the classic BBQ side dish. Tender elbow pasta is tossed with roasted corn, black beans, fresh vegetables, and a tangy lime yogurt dressing for a colorful, zesty salad that’s perfect for picnics, potlucks, and summer gatherings.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:6:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:130;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:9:"large pot";s:5:"notes";s:17:"for cooking pasta";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:429;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:8:"colander";s:5:"notes";s:18:"for draining pasta";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:763;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"grill or oven";s:5:"notes";s:29:"for roasting or grilling corn";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:150;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:12:"mixing bowls";s:5:"notes";s:46:"one small for dressing and one large for salad";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:364;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:5:"whisk";s:5:"notes";s:19:"for mixing dressing";}i:5;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:680;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:23:"knife and cutting board";s:5:"notes";s:23:"for chopping vegetables";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:214:"

Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the elbow macaroni according to the package directions until al dente. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool the pasta and stop the cooking. Set aside.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:216:"

Brush the corn ears lightly with oil. Grill over high heat turning occasionally until lightly charred, or roast in the oven at 425°F (220°C) for 12–15 minutes. Let cool, then slice the kernels off the cob.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:195:"

In a small bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, sour cream, lime juice, chili powder, cumin, minced garlic, and kosher salt until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:165:"

In a large mixing bowl combine the cooked macaroni, corn kernels, black beans, cherry tomatoes, diced bell pepper, chopped red onion, cilantro, and jalapeño.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:211:"

Pour the creamy lime dressing over the salad and gently toss until everything is evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving. Taste and adjust salt or lime juice if needed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Do not overcook the pasta so it holds its texture after mixing with the dressing. Chill the salad for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to blend. If the salad thickens in the fridge, stir in a spoonful of yogurt, mayo, or a splash of lime juice before serving to restore creaminess. Dice vegetables small so every bite has a balanced mix of flavors.

item.title: Slow Cooker Crockpot French Dip Sandwiches
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These slow cooker Crockpot French Dip Sandwiches are a cozy, no-fuss dinner that practically cooks itself. A seasoned chuck roast slowly cooks in a savory broth with Worcestershire sauce and soy sauce until fall-apart tender. The shredded beef is piled onto warm hoagie rolls, topped with melty provolone if desired, and served with the rich cooking juices for dipping.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:6:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:778;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:22:"slow cooker (crockpot)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:490;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"large skillet";s:5:"notes";s:21:"for searing the roast";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:132;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:5:"tongs";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:248;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:11:"mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:779;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:9:"two forks";s:5:"notes";s:22:"for shredding the beef";}i:5;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:98;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:5:"knife";s:5:"notes";s:17:"for slicing rolls";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:159:"

Pat the chuck roast dry with paper towels. Rub it with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder until the entire roast is evenly coated.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:155:"

Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the roast for about 3–4 minutes per side until browned. This step is optional but adds extra flavor.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:119:"

Place the roast in the slow cooker. In a bowl, mix together the beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, and soy sauce.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:60:"

Pour the broth mixture over the beef in the crockpot.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:108:"

Cover and cook on LOW for about 8 hours, until the beef is very tender and easily shreds with a fork.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:171:"

Remove the roast and let it rest for about 5 minutes. Shred the meat using two forks, then return the shredded beef to the slow cooker so it can soak in the juices.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:213:"

Slice the hoagie rolls open. Add provolone cheese if desired and broil for 1–2 minutes until melted. Pile the shredded beef onto the rolls and serve with small bowls of the slow cooker juices for dipping.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Let the roast rest a few minutes before shredding to keep it juicy. Use sturdy hoagie or French rolls so they hold up to the dipping sauce. For extra flavor, add sliced onions or bell peppers to the slow cooker while cooking. You can also spread garlic butter on the rolls before broiling for extra richness.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Blue Cream Cocktail
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A smooth and visually striking cocktail with a soft blue hue and a creamy finish. This easy-to-make drink blends vodka, coffee liqueur, and blue curaçao, topped with rich cream for a balanced and relaxing evening treat.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:54:"

Fill a rocks glass with ice to chill the drink.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:81:"

Pour the vodka and coffee liqueur over the ice and stir gently to combine.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:93:"

Slowly add the blue curaçao, allowing it to settle and create a layered color effect.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:83:"

Carefully pour the heavy cream over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:73:"

Lightly stir for a marbled look or leave layered for presentation.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:47:"

Serve immediately while cold and smooth.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Chill your glass beforehand for the best experience. Use fresh heavy cream for a smoother texture. Pour slowly to achieve a layered look, or stir gently for a marbled effect. Coconut cream works well for a dairy-free option.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Strawberry Shortcake Easter Egg Bombs
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These pretty spring desserts feature a smooth white chocolate shell filled with a fluffy strawberry shortcake cream made with cream cheese, jam, freeze-dried strawberries, and crushed biscuits. They are festive, make-ahead friendly, and perfect for Easter brunch, baby showers, and spring dessert tables.
item.category: pink candy melts, optional for color

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:5:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:654;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:19:"microwave-safe bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:800;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:16:"egg-shaped molds";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:248;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:11:"mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:801;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:25:"hand mixer or stand mixer";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:802;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:21:"spoon or pastry brush";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}
