a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:137:"

Melt the white chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl in 30-second intervals, stirring between each interval, until smooth and glossy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:161:"

Coat the inside of the egg-shaped molds evenly with the melted white chocolate using a spoon or pastry brush. Refrigerate for about 15 minutes until firm.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:121:"

In a mixing bowl, whip together the heavy cream, cream cheese, and powdered sugar until light, fluffy, and creamy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:132:"

Fold in the vanilla extract, strawberry jam, freeze-dried strawberries, and crushed shortcake biscuits until evenly combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:124:"

Spoon the filling into half of the chilled chocolate egg halves, leaving a little space around the edges for sealing.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:131:"

Top with the remaining chocolate halves and gently press to seal. Return to the refrigerator for 10 to 15 minutes until set.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:169:"

Drizzle with melted pink chocolate and decorate with crushed shortcake crumbs, fresh strawberry slices, and optional edible gold sprinkles before serving chilled.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use good-quality white chocolate for a smoother, shinier shell. Chill the shells thoroughly before filling, and do not overfill so the halves seal neatly. The filling should be whipped until light and fluffy enough to hold its shape. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days or freeze for up to 3 months; thaw overnight in the refrigerator before serving. Serve chilled for the best texture.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Homemade Corned Beef and Cabbage
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A cozy, slow-cooked dinner with tender corned beef, sweet carrots, buttery cabbage, and savory broth. This hearty meal is perfect for St. Patrick’s Day, Sunday supper, or any chilly evening when you want something warm, generous, and deeply satisfying.
item.category: cabbage, sliced into 8 thick wedges with the core intact
carrots, peeled and cut into 3-inch diagonal chunks
fresh parsley, finely chopped, for serving

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:8:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:0;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:205:"

Pat the corned beef dry with paper towels. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then sear the corned beef for 2 to 4 minutes per side until browned. Transfer it to the slow cooker.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:212:"

In the same skillet, pour in the broth and stir in the mustard. Scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom of the pan, bring the mixture to a boil, then pour it over the corned beef in the slow cooker.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:2;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:190:"

Add the smashed garlic, onion, peppercorns, thyme sprigs, bay leaves, and celery seed to the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours, until the corned beef is very tender.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:3;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:168:"

Add the carrots around the meat in the slow cooker. Cover again and continue cooking on low for 1 to 2 hours, until the carrots are tender but not falling apart.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:4;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:263:"

While the carrots finish cooking, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the cabbage wedges, sprinkle with the salt, and cook for about 10 minutes, turning gently once or twice, until slightly softened and lightly golden around the edges.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:5;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:205:"

Transfer the cabbage wedges to the slow cooker, nestling them around the meat and carrots. Cover and cook on low for another 30 to 60 minutes, until the cabbage is tender and infused with the broth.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:6;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:132:"

Lift the corned beef out of the slow cooker and place it on a cutting board. Let it rest for about 10 minutes before slicing.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:7;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:7;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 8";s:4:"text";s:291:"

Slice the corned beef against the grain into thick slices. Arrange the beef on a serving platter with the carrots, cabbage, and roasted potatoes. Spoon a little cooking liquid over the top, then sprinkle with chopped parsley and fresh chives. Serve with horseradish sauce on the side.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Searing the corned beef first adds richer flavor, but the recipe will still work if skipped. Add the carrots later so they stay tender without turning mushy, and keep the cabbage wedges thick with part of the core intact so they hold together. Slice the corned beef against the grain for the most tender texture. Store leftovers with a little broth to keep the meat moist when reheating.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: 10 Cute Easter Cookie Ideas to Make This Spring
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This Easter cookie roundup brings together 10 playful and pretty ideas for spring baking, from pastel bunny sugar cookies and speckled egg cookies to fluffy lamb faces, bunny butts, stained glass crosses, and nest-topped chocolate cookies. The collection features a mix of sugar cookies, shortbread, thumbprints, and chocolate cookies baked mostly at 325°F to 350°F and finished with royal icing, frosting, coconut, marshmallows, candy melts, and mini candies.
item.category: sugar cookie mix or refrigerated sugar cookie dough

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:10:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:361:"

Choose one or more Easter cookie designs from the roundup, such as pastel bunny sugar cookies, speckled egg cookies, fluffy lamb face cookies, baby chick thumbprint cookies, carrot patch shortbread cookies, stained glass cross cookies, bunny butt cookies, polka dot Easter egg cookies, glittery bunny silhouette cookies, or nest-topped chocolate cookies.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:261:"

Prepare the cookie base that matches your chosen design, using sugar cookie dough, lemon cookie dough, shortbread dough, or chocolate cookie dough. Several ideas use sugar cookie mix with butter and egg or refrigerated sugar cookie dough for convenience.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:232:"

Roll or portion the dough as needed. For shaped cookies like bunnies, eggs, and crosses, roll the dough to about 1/4 inch thick before cutting. For thumbprint cookies, form 1-inch balls and press an indentation in the center.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:115:"

Chill shaped dough when needed before baking so details like bunny ears hold their shape better in the oven.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:160:"

Bake most cookies at 350°F for about 8 to 10 minutes, depending on the style. Carrot patch shortbread cookies bake at 325°F for about 10 to 12 minutes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:164:"

Let the cookies cool before decorating. For stained glass cross cookies, cool them completely on the pan so the melted candy center can set without breaking.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:493:"

Decorate each cookie according to its design: use pastel royal icing for bunny, egg, and silhouette cookies; vanilla frosting and coconut for lamb faces; yellow glaze, candy eyes, and orange sprinkles for chick thumbprints; chocolate frosting with carrot piping for carrot patch cookies; melted hard candy centers for stained glass crosses; coconut, marshmallows, and candy-melt feet for bunny butt cookies; and piped chocolate frosting with mini eggs for nest-topped chocolate cookies.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:7;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 8";s:4:"text";s:276:"

Use the helpful finishing tips from the roundup for the cleanest look: let base icing dry before speckling egg cookies, add polka dots while the icing is still wet, make bunny feet ahead of time, and press mini eggs into chocolate nests before the frosting crusts over.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:8;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 9";s:4:"text";s:113:"

Allow decorated cookies to set fully before stacking, boxing, or arranging them on an Easter dessert tray.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:9;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:7:"Step 10";s:4:"text";s:139:"

Serve the cookies for Easter brunch, family parties, classroom treats, spring dessert platters, gift boxes, or holiday cookie trays.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

This post is a recipe-style roundup rather than one single dough formula. Most ideas use sugar cookie, lemon cookie, shortbread, or chocolate cookie bases and are decorated after baking. Beginner-friendly picks include baby chick thumbprint cookies and polka dot Easter egg cookies. For elegant presentation, speckled egg cookies, glittery bunny silhouette cookies, and stained glass cross cookies stand out. The nutrition values below are broad estimated averages for one decorated Easter cookie idea serving because the article contains multiple cookie variations rather than one standardized formula.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Korean Ground Beef Bowls
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A quick, cozy weeknight dinner with savory ground beef, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and warm rice. These Korean Ground Beef Bowls are easy to customize with fresh toppings like cucumber, kimchi, sesame seeds, and green onions, making them a flexible and satisfying meal for busy nights.

topping";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:874;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:408:"

Cook the rice so everything is ready at the same time. For the stovetop method, rinse 1 cup of rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Add it to a pot with 2 cups of water, bring it to a boil, then lower the heat, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes until the water is absorbed. Let it sit off the heat for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. You can also use a rice cooker or Instant Pot.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:180:"

Set a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the ground beef. Break it up with a spatula as it cooks and let it brown until it’s no longer pink, about 5 to 7 minutes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:156:"

If there’s a lot of grease in the pan, drain off the excess. Stir in the minced garlic and ginger and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, just until fragrant.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:183:"

Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, and chopped green onions. Season with salt and pepper to taste, then let the mixture simmer for another couple of minutes so the flavors combine.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:247:"

Spoon cooked rice into each bowl, then top with the seasoned ground beef. Finish with any toppings you like, such as cucumber, kimchi, sesame seeds, extra green onions, steamed broccoli, sautéed peppers, pickled vegetables, or a fried egg.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

This recipe is intentionally simple and works best as a flavorful base bowl. For extra texture and flavor, add toppings like cucumber, kimchi, sesame seeds, extra green onions, steamed broccoli, sautéed peppers, pickled vegetables, or a fried egg. Use tamari for a gluten-free version. Ground turkey, ground chicken, plant-based ground, tofu, tempeh, or finely chopped mushrooms can be substituted for the beef. Store leftover beef and rice in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days, keeping crunchy toppings separate until serving.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Chicken Piccata
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A bright and elegant Italian-inspired dish featuring tender chicken cutlets in a buttery lemon and caper sauce. Quick enough for weeknights yet refined enough for guests.
item.category: chicken broth or dry white wine

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:131:"

Slice each chicken breast horizontally into thin cutlets and gently pound if needed. Season both sides with salt and pepper.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:62:"

Lightly dredge each piece in flour, shaking off excess.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:158:"

Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Transfer to a plate.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:116:"

In the same pan, sauté garlic briefly if using. Add chicken broth and lemon juice, scraping up browned bits.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:105:"

Stir in capers and simmer for 2–3 minutes. Reduce heat and add butter until the sauce is smooth.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:86:"

Return chicken to the pan and spoon sauce over. Warm through for 1–2 minutes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:64:"

Garnish with parsley and lemon slices. Serve immediately.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}
Keep chicken thin for even cooking. Use fresh lemon juice for best flavor. Avoid overcrowding the pan to ensure proper browning. If the sauce tastes too sharp, add a bit more butter to balance it.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Easter Carrot Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This Easter carrot cake is soft, moist, and filled with warm spices, sweet carrots, and optional pineapple for extra tenderness. Finished with a rich and tangy cream cheese frosting, it’s a cozy spring dessert perfect for Easter dinner, brunch gatherings, or any celebration where a homemade cake makes the table feel special.
item.category: 9x13 inch baking pan or two 9-inch cake pans
carrot cake with cream cheese frosting

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:8:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:115:"

Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9×13 inch baking pan or two 9-inch round cake pans.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:127:"

In a medium bowl whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg until evenly combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:127:"

In a large bowl whisk together the granulated sugar, brown sugar, vegetable oil, eggs, and vanilla extract until smooth.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:86:"

Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir gently until just combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:89:"

Fold in the grated carrots, crushed pineapple, chopped nuts, and raisins if using.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:185:"

Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 35–40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Allow the cake to cool completely before frosting.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:90:"

In a mixing bowl beat the cream cheese and butter together until smooth and fluffy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:7;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 8";s:4:"text";s:182:"

Gradually add the powdered sugar while mixing on low speed, then stir in the vanilla extract and a pinch of salt until smooth. Spread the frosting evenly over the cooled cake.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Finely grate the carrots so they blend smoothly into the cake and create a tender texture. Avoid overmixing the batter to keep the cake light and moist. Toasting the walnuts or pecans for about 5 minutes enhances their flavor. For decoration, sprinkle chopped nuts, toasted coconut, candy eggs, or pipe small frosting carrots. Store the frosted cake covered in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. Unfrosted cake can be frozen for up to 3 months.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Honey Glazed Easter Ham
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This honey glazed Easter ham is a classic holiday centerpiece. A fully cooked bone-in ham warms slowly in the oven while a sweet and savory glaze made with honey, brown sugar, Dijon mustard, and warm spices caramelizes into a glossy golden coating. The result is tender, juicy slices packed with flavor — perfect for Easter dinner, spring gatherings, or festive family meals.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:11:{i:0;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:39:"fully cooked bone-in ham (7–9 pounds)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:901;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:5:"honey";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:368;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:11:"brown sugar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:51;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:13:"Dijon mustard";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:73;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:19:"apple cider vinegar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:271;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:15:"ground cinnamon";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:52;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:13:"ground cloves";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:902;}i:7;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:12:"black pepper";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:367;}i:8;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:35:"pineapple slices (optional garnish)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:903;}i:9;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:38:"maraschino cherries (optional garnish)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:904;}i:10;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:30:"fresh herbs (optional garnish)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:905;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:157:"

Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Place the ham cut side down in a roasting pan and cover loosely with foil to keep the moisture in while it heats.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:116:"

Bake the ham for 1½ to 2 hours, about 15 minutes per pound, until the ham is heated through but still juicy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:254:"

While the ham warms, combine honey, brown sugar, Dijon mustard, apple cider vinegar, cinnamon, cloves, and black pepper in a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring until the sugar dissolves and the glaze becomes smooth.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:238:"

During the last 30 minutes of baking, remove the foil. Brush a generous layer of glaze over the ham and return it to the oven uncovered. Brush with additional glaze every 10 minutes until the surface becomes glossy and caramelized.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:190:"

Remove the ham from the oven and let it rest for about 10 minutes before slicing. Serve slices with extra glaze from the pan and garnish with pineapple, cherries, or herbs if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For best flavor, lightly score the ham in a diamond pattern before baking so the glaze penetrates the meat. Keep the ham covered with foil for most of the cooking time to prevent it from drying out. A meat thermometer should read about 140°F when the ham is fully reheated. Leftovers can be refrigerated for up to 4 days or frozen for 2 months. Chopped leftover ham works well in omelets, fried rice, sandwiches, or potato soup.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Deviled Eggs for Easter
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: Classic creamy deviled eggs made with mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, and a touch of vinegar for brightness. Finished with paprika, these simple eggs are a perfect Easter appetizer and always one of the first dishes to disappear at spring gatherings.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:6:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:752;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:10:"medium pot";s:5:"notes";s:16:"for boiling eggs";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:248;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:11:"mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:25:"for preparing the filling";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:444;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:4:"fork";s:5:"notes";s:21:"for mashing egg yolks";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:98;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:5:"knife";s:5:"notes";s:24:"for slicing eggs in half";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:910;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:19:"piping bag or spoon";s:5:"notes";s:20:"for filling the eggs";}i:5;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:911;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"serving plate";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:171:"

Place the eggs in a pot and cover them with cold water. Bring the water to a boil, then turn off the heat, cover the pot, and let the eggs sit for 10 to 12 minutes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:109:"

Transfer the eggs to a bowl of ice water and let them cool for about 5 minutes to make peeling easier.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:160:"

Peel the eggs and slice each one in half lengthwise. Carefully remove the yolks and place them in a bowl, then arrange the egg whites on a serving plate.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:166:"

Mash the egg yolks with a fork until smooth. Add the mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, white vinegar, salt, and black pepper, then mix until creamy and well combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:92:"

Spoon or pipe the creamy yolk mixture back into the hollow centers of the egg whites.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:165:"

Sprinkle the filled eggs with paprika and add optional toppings such as chopped chives, bacon bits, pickle relish, or sliced olives if desired. Serve chilled.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For easier peeling, use eggs that are a few days old rather than very fresh eggs. A piping bag or zip-top bag with the corner cut off helps create a neat, decorative filling. Chill the deviled eggs for about 30 minutes before serving to improve flavor and texture. Store leftovers in a covered container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. For a vegan variation, use halved small boiled potatoes or tofu pieces as the base and replace the yolks with mashed chickpeas mixed with vegan mayonnaise, mustard, and vinegar.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Lemon Easter Bundt Cake
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A bright and fresh spring dessert perfect for Easter. This soft lemon Bundt cake is moist, fluffy, and full of real lemon flavor from fresh juice and zest. Finished with a light lemon glaze, it makes a beautiful centerpiece for Easter brunch or dessert.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:125:"

Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a Bundt pan thoroughly so the cake releases easily after baking.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:118:"

In a medium bowl whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Set the dry ingredients aside.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:221:"

In a large bowl beat the butter and sugar together for 3 to 4 minutes until light and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Stir in lemon zest, fresh lemon juice, and vanilla extract.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:135:"

Add the dry ingredients and buttermilk alternately, beginning and ending with the flour mixture. Mix gently until just combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:222:"

Pour the batter into the prepared Bundt pan and bake for 45 to 55 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then invert onto a cooling rack.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:160:"

Whisk powdered sugar and lemon juice together until smooth to make the glaze. Drizzle over the cooled cake and sprinkle lemon zest on top before serving.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use fresh lemons for the best flavor. Avoid overmixing the batter to keep the cake light and fluffy. Grease the Bundt pan thoroughly to prevent sticking. For a variation, add 1 tablespoon of poppy seeds for a lemon poppy seed cake.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Easter Strawberry Shortcake Trifle
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This Easter Strawberry Shortcake Trifle is a light and festive spring dessert made with layers of soft cake cubes, juicy macerated strawberries, and fluffy homemade whipped cream. Served in a glass trifle bowl, the beautiful layers make it perfect for Easter dinner, spring gatherings, or any celebration where you want an easy but impressive dessert.
item.category: large glass trifle bowl or trifle dish
pound cake or vanilla sponge cake, cut into cubes

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:6:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:412;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:17:"large mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:701;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:28:"electric mixer or hand mixer";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:98;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:5:"knife";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:99;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"cutting board";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:924;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:38:"large glass trifle bowl or trifle dish";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:5;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:925;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:29:"spatula or spoon for layering";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:10:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:5:"pound";s:4:"name";s:49:"pound cake or vanilla sponge cake, cut into cubes";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:926;s:2:"id";i:927;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"4";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:26:"fresh strawberries, sliced";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:928;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:16:"granulated sugar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:45;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:11:"lemon juice";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:117;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:20:"heavy whipping cream";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:54;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:14:"powdered sugar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:58;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:15:"vanilla extract";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:59;}i:7;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:41:"whole strawberries for garnish (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:929;}i:8;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:34:"mint leaves for garnish (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:930;}i:9;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:47:"white chocolate shavings for garnish (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:931;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:4:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:202:"

Place the sliced strawberries in a bowl. Add the granulated sugar and lemon juice, then gently stir. Let the strawberries sit for about 15 minutes so they release their juices and become sweeter.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:181:"

In a mixing bowl combine the heavy whipping cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract. Beat the mixture until soft peaks form and the whipped cream becomes light and fluffy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:261:"

In a large glass bowl or trifle dish, start layering the dessert with cake cubes, then a layer of strawberries with some of their juices, followed by a layer of whipped cream. Repeat the layers until the bowl is full, finishing with whipped cream on top.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:191:"

Decorate the top with fresh strawberries, mint leaves, and white chocolate shavings if desired. Refrigerate the trifle for at least 1 hour before serving so the flavors blend together.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use ripe strawberries for the best flavor and natural sweetness. Cut the cake into even cubes so the layers look neat and uniform in the trifle bowl. Chill the dessert for at least 1 hour before serving so the flavors blend together and the cream holds its shape. For a vegan version, replace pound cake with vegan sponge cake and use coconut whipped cream while keeping the powdered sugar and vanilla the same. Store covered in the refrigerator for up to 2 days; the cake will soften slightly as it absorbs the strawberry juices.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Easter Hot Cross Buns
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: Hot cross buns are a traditional Easter treat made with soft, lightly sweet yeast dough, warm spices, and raisins. Finished with their classic flour cross and a shiny apricot glaze, these fluffy buns are perfect for Easter breakfast, brunch, or a cozy dessert with tea or coffee.
item.category: piping bag or small plastic bag

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:5:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:412;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:17:"large mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:233;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:25:"measuring cups and spoons";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:935;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:27:"mixing spoon or dough whisk";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:65;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:11:"baking tray";s:5:"notes";s:26:"lined with parchment paper";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:936;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:31:"piping bag or small plastic bag";s:5:"notes";s:26:"for piping the flour cross";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:14:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"3.5";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:17:"all purpose flour";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:33;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:4:"0.25";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:16:"granulated teaspoons)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:544;s:2:"id";i:937;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:15:"ground milk";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:44;}i:7;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:4:"0.25";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:23:"unsalted butter, topping)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:940;}i:12;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:11:"apricot jam";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:941;}i:13;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:4:"tbsp";s:4:"name";s:22:"warm water (for glaze)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:71;s:2:"id";i:942;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:7:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:123:"

In a bowl, combine the warm milk and active dry yeast. Let the mixture sit for about 5 minutes until slightly foamy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:176:"

In a large bowl mix the flour, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Add the yeast mixture, melted butter, and eggs. Mix until a soft dough forms, then fold in the raisins.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:205:"

Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise for about 1 hour or until doubled in size.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:195:"

Punch down the dough and divide it into 12 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and place them on a lined baking tray with space between them. Cover and let rise again for 30 minutes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:141:"

Mix the flour and water to form a thick paste. Pipe the paste over the buns in straight lines to create the traditional cross pattern.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:86:"

Bake the buns in a 375°F (190°C) oven for 18–20 minutes until golden brown.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:152:"

Warm the apricot jam with 1 tablespoon of water and brush it over the hot buns to give them a shiny glaze. Let them cool slightly before serving.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Do not overheat the milk when activating the yeast; it should be warm, not hot. For extra flavor, add 1 teaspoon of orange zest to the dough. These buns are best served slightly warm with butter. For a vegan version, replace milk with almond or oat milk, butter with plant-based butter, and eggs with 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days or freeze for up to 2 months and reheat in the oven.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Easter Bunny Coconut Tails
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These Easter Bunny Coconut Tails are adorable no-bake coconut candy balls with a creamy center. Each one is dipped in pastel-colored white chocolate and rolled in shredded coconut to resemble fluffy bunny tails. They are simple to make, festive for spring celebrations, and perfect for Easter dessert tables or holiday treat platters.
item.category: pastel gel food coloring (pink, yellow, blue, or green)
white candy melts or white chocolate

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:200:"

In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded coconut, sweetened condensed milk, vanilla extract, and salt. Stir well until the mixture becomes thick and sticky and the coconut is evenly coated.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:146:"

Use a tablespoon or small cookie scoop to portion the mixture. Roll each portion between your palms to form balls about 1 inch in diameter.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:153:"

Place the coconut balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Transfer the tray to the refrigerator and chill for 1 to 2 hours until firm.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:228:"

Melt the white candy melts or white chocolate in the microwave in 20 to 30 second intervals, stirring between each heating until smooth. Divide the melted chocolate into small bowls and tint with pastel gel food coloring.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:231:"

Remove the chilled coconut balls from the refrigerator. Using a fork or dipping tool, lower each ball into the melted chocolate and turn gently until fully coated. Tap the fork lightly on the bowl to remove excess chocolate.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:200:"

Place the coated balls back onto the parchment-lined tray and immediately sprinkle or roll them in shredded coconut before the chocolate sets. Let the coating firm up completely before serving.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For best results, chill the coconut balls well before dipping so they hold their shape. Work in small batches and keep the remaining balls refrigerated while coating. A cookie scoop helps keep the treats uniform in size. For variations, add almond extract for a nutty flavor, lemon zest for brightness, mini chocolate chips for texture, or drizzle dark chocolate over the finished coconut tails.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Easter Chocolate Nest Cookies
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These Easter Chocolate Nest Cookies are a fun and festive no-bake treat made with crunchy cereal coated in melted chocolate and butterscotch. Shaped like little bird nests and filled with colorful candy eggs, they are perfect for Easter dessert tables, spring parties, and easy baking projects with kids.
item.category: chow mein noodles or crispy rice cereal
mini candy eggs or chocolate eggs

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:8:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:654;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:19:"microwave safe bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:960;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:9:"microwave";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:412;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:17:"large mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:961;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:23:"mixing spoon or spatula";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:507;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:12:"baking sheet";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:5;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:153;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:15:"parchment paper";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:6;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:962;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:26:"tablespoon or cookie scoop";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:7;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:655;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:12:"refrigerator";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:6:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"3";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:39:"chow mein noodles or crispy rice cereal";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:963;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"1 1/2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:26:"semi sweet chocolate chips";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:964;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:18:"butterscotch chips";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:965;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:15:"vanilla extract";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:59;}i:4;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:2:"36";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:33:"mini candy eggs or chocolate eggs";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:966;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:5:"pinch";s:4:"name";s:15:"salt (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:268;s:2:"id";i:579;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:263:"

In a microwave safe bowl, combine the chocolate chips and butterscotch chips. Heat in 20 to 30 second intervals, stirring between each round, until the mixture is completely melted and smooth. Stir in the vanilla extract and a small pinch of salt if using.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:214:"

Place the chow mein noodles or crispy rice cereal in a large bowl. Pour the melted chocolate mixture over the cereal and gently stir until everything is evenly coated while keeping the cereal texture intact.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:212:"

Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Scoop about two tablespoons of the mixture onto the tray and use the back of a spoon to gently shape each mound into a nest with a small indentation in the center.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:139:"

While the nests are still soft, place three mini candy eggs in the center of each nest and press them lightly so they stay in place.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:176:"

Place the tray in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes or until the chocolate has fully hardened. Once set, carefully lift the nests from the parchment paper and serve.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Work quickly when shaping the nests because the chocolate mixture begins to firm as it cools. Use parchment paper to prevent sticking and make cleanup easier. Smaller nests look more delicate and are easier to serve. You can customize the recipe by adding peanut butter to the chocolate mixture, using white chocolate for a lighter look, sprinkling shredded coconut for a fluffy nest appearance, or swapping cereal for crushed pretzels for a sweet and salty variation.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Carrot Cake Cream Cheese Cookies
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: Soft carrot cake cream cheese cookies filled with freshly grated carrots, warm cinnamon spice, and topped with a smooth cream cheese frosting. These tender cookies bring all the cozy flavors of classic carrot cake into an easy handheld dessert perfect for Easter, spring gatherings, or a sweet afternoon treat.

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:9:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:135:"

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper so the cookies bake evenly and release easily.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:126:"

In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt until well combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:161:"

In a large bowl, beat the softened butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Add the egg and vanilla extract and mix until smooth.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:101:"

Stir in the finely grated carrots and the chopped nuts if using. Mix until evenly distributed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:120:"

Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix just until a soft dough forms. Avoid overmixing.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:149:"

Use a tablespoon or small cookie scoop to drop portions of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving about two inches between each cookie.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:159:"

Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the edges are lightly golden and the centers are set. Transfer cookies to a wire rack and allow them to cool completely.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:7;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 8";s:4:"text";s:146:"

In a small bowl, beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth. Add powdered sugar and vanilla extract and mix until creamy and spreadable.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:8;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 9";s:4:"text";s:77:"

Spread a small spoonful of frosting over each cooled cookie and serve.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For the best texture, grate the carrots finely so they blend smoothly into the dough. Avoid overbaking to keep the cookies soft and tender. Always allow cookies to cool completely before frosting so the cream cheese topping does not melt. Optional variations include adding raisins, shredded coconut, chopped walnuts, or a little orange zest for extra flavor.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Easter Breakfast Casserole
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This Easter breakfast casserole is a warm, comforting diner-style brunch dish made with layers of bread, savory sausage, eggs, and melted cheese. It bakes into a golden, hearty casserole that is perfect for feeding a family on Easter morning and can easily be prepared ahead of time.

powder";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:780;}i:10;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"0.5";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:18:"diced bell peppers";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:981;}i:11;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:4:"0.25";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:20:"chopped green onions";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:982;}i:12;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:44:"extra shredded cheese for topping (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:983;}i:13;a:6:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"unit";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:44:"fresh chopped parsley for garnish (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:2:"id";i:984;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:148:"

Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly grease a 9×13 inch baking dish. Spread the bread cubes evenly across the bottom of the dish.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:199:"

In a skillet over medium heat, cook the breakfast sausage until browned and fully cooked, breaking it into crumbles. Drain any excess grease and spread the sausage evenly over the bread cubes.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:158:"

Sprinkle the shredded cheddar and mozzarella cheese over the sausage layer. Add the diced bell peppers and chopped green onions evenly across the dish.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:128:"

In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder until fully combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:220:"

Pour the egg mixture evenly over the casserole so the bread absorbs the liquid. Let the casserole sit for about 10 minutes so the bread can soak up the mixture. If preparing ahead, cover and refrigerate overnight.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:173:"

Bake the casserole for 40 to 45 minutes until the center is set and the top is lightly golden. If desired, sprinkle extra cheese during the last 10 minutes of baking.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For the best texture, use slightly stale bread so it absorbs the egg mixture well. Let the casserole rest for about 10 minutes after baking before slicing. You can prepare the entire dish the night before and refrigerate it overnight before baking. Try variations such as replacing sausage with ham or bacon, or adding vegetables like spinach, mushrooms, or tomatoes.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Pineapple Coconut No-Bake Balls
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These pineapple coconut no-bake balls are soft, creamy, sweet, and full of tropical flavor. Made with crushed pineapple, shredded coconut, sweetened condensed milk, and vanilla, they come together quickly with no baking required and chill into an easy little treat that is perfect for sharing.
item.category: sweetened shredded coconut, plus extra for rolling

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:6:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:26:"crushed pineapple, drained";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:993;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:5:"1 1/2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:50:"sweetened shredded coconut, plus extra for rolling";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:994;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:24:"sweetened condensed milk";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:952;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:14:"powdered sugar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:58;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:8:"teaspoon";s:4:"name";s:15:"vanilla extract";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:157;s:2:"id";i:59;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:5:"pinch";s:4:"name";s:4:"salt";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:268;s:2:"id";i:36;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:200:"

In a medium bowl, stir together the drained crushed pineapple, 1 1/2 cups shredded coconut, sweetened condensed milk, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt until evenly combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:89:"

Cover the bowl and refrigerate the mixture for about 30 minutes so it can firm up.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:159:"

Scoop about 1 tablespoon of mixture at a time and roll into small balls with your hands. Lightly grease your hands with coconut oil or butter if needed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:149:"

Place extra shredded coconut in a small bowl and roll each ball in the coconut until coated. Set the balls on a parchment-lined tray or plate.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:92:"

Refrigerate the finished balls for another 30 minutes until firm, then serve chilled.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Drain the crushed pineapple very well before mixing so the mixture is not too wet. If the mixture feels sticky while shaping, lightly grease your hands with coconut oil or butter. Chill fully before rolling and again after coating for the best texture. Coconut extract can be used instead of vanilla for a stronger coconut flavor. Serve chilled.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter No Bake Cookies
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These chocolate peanut butter no bake cookies are a rich, chewy, and comforting treat made with cocoa, creamy peanut butter, and hearty oats. Everything comes together in one saucepan, then the cookies are simply spooned onto parchment paper to set. Perfect for warm days when you want a homemade dessert without turning on the oven.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:5:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:441;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:15:"medium saucepan";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:443;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:23:"wooden spoon or spatula";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:716;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:13:"baking sheets";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:999;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:28:"parchment paper or wax paper";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:1000;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:21:"cookie scoop or spoon";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:11:"ingredients";a:11:{i:0;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:15:"unsalted butter";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:388;}i:1;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"2";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:16:"granulated sugar";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:45;}i:2;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:4:"milk";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:501;}i:3;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:24:"unsweetened cocoa powder";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:656;}i:4;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"1";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:15:"vanilla extract";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:59;}i:5;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:20:"creamy peanut butter";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:1001;}i:6;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:1:"3";s:4:"unit";s:4:"cups";s:4:"name";s:10:"quick oats";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:32;s:2:"id";i:1002;}i:7;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/4";s:4:"unit";s:3:"tsp";s:4:"name";s:4:"salt";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:34;s:2:"id";i:36;}i:8;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:27:"shredded coconut (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:1003;}i:9;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/2";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:26:"chopped peanuts (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:1004;}i:10;a:7:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:6:"amount";s:3:"1/3";s:4:"unit";s:3:"cup";s:4:"name";s:31:"mini chocolate chips (optional)";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";s:7:"unit_id";i:29;s:2:"id";i:242;}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:6:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:101:"

Line two baking sheets with parchment paper or wax paper to prevent the cookies from sticking.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:261:"

In a medium saucepan combine the butter, sugar, milk, and cocoa powder. Place over medium heat and stir constantly until the butter melts and the mixture combines. Bring the mixture to a full boil and allow it to boil for exactly 1 minute while stirring.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:142:"

Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the peanut butter, vanilla extract, and salt until the mixture becomes smooth and glossy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:166:"

Add the quick oats and stir until the oats are completely coated in the chocolate mixture. If using coconut, chopped nuts, or chocolate chips, mix them in now.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:149:"

Using a spoon or cookie scoop, drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto the prepared parchment paper and gently shape into cookie rounds if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:172:"

Allow the cookies to sit at room temperature for about 30 minutes until firm. If needed, place them in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes to help them set faster.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Boiling the chocolate mixture for exactly one minute helps the cookies set properly. If boiled too long the cookies may become dry, and if boiled too little they may stay soft. Quick oats give the best texture, while old fashioned oats create a chewier cookie. Optional additions like shredded coconut, chopped peanuts, or mini chocolate chips can be mixed in for extra flavor. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 5 days, refrigerate for up to 1 week, or freeze for up to 2 months.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.content:encoded: Crispy fish tacos filled with golden pan-fried white fish, crunchy lime cabbage slaw, creamy lime crema, and fresh toppings. These bright and flavorful tacos deliver the perfect balance of crispy, fresh, and tangy flavors for an easy dinner or casual gathering.

In a medium bowl combine the shredded green cabbage, red cabbage, and cilantro. Add lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper and toss gently until evenly coated. Set aside to allow the flavors to develop.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:130:"

In a small bowl stir together the sour cream, lime juice, lime zest, and salt until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:283:"

Pat the fish fillets dry and cut them into strips about 1 inch wide. In a shallow bowl mix the flour, salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and chili powder. Place the milk in a separate bowl. Dip each fish piece into the milk, then coat lightly in the seasoned flour mixture.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:228:"

Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Fry the coated fish pieces for about 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate to drain.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:145:"

Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for about 30 seconds on each side, or wrap them in foil and heat briefly in the oven.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:197:"

Place a few pieces of crispy fish in each tortilla. Top with cabbage slaw, avocado slices, and a drizzle of lime crema. Finish with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice before serving.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For a lighter option, grill the seasoned fish instead of frying. Add cayenne pepper to the flour mixture for extra heat or mix hot sauce into the lime crema. You can also add diced mango to the slaw for a sweet twist. If preparing ahead, keep the fish warm in a low oven while frying the remaining batches and store leftover slaw in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Lavender Honey Shortbread Cookies
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: These lavender honey shortbread cookies are soft, buttery, and delicately floral with a gentle sweetness from honey. Perfect for spring gatherings, tea time, or elegant homemade gifts, they offer a refined twist on classic shortbread.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:156:"

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:150:"

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:107:"

Gather the dough into a ball, wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for about 30 minutes to firm up.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:164:"

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:5;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 6";s:4:"text";s:120:"

Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until edges are lightly golden while tops remain pale. Cool completely on a wire rack.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:6;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 7";s:4:"text";s:138:"

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use only culinary-grade lavender to avoid bitterness. Do not overuse lavender, as the flavor can become overpowering. Keep the dough chilled for best shaping results. item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A refreshing two-ingredient summer drink made with juicy watermelon and fresh lime juice. Naturally sweet, hydrating, and ready in minutes, this cooler is perfect for warm days.

item.title: Easy Dandelion Lemonade
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: This Easy Dandelion Lemonade is fresh, gently floral, and beautifully lemony. A cold infusion of clean dandelion petals is mixed with fresh lemon juice, honey or simple syrup, cold water, and a tiny pinch of sea salt for a golden spring drink.

fresh dandelion petals, yellow parts only

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:5:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:374:"

Gather dandelions from a clean, unsprayed area. Choose bright, open blossoms that look fresh. Avoid flowers from roadsides, treated lawns, public walkways, or any spot where you’re unsure about chemicals or contamination. Separate the yellow petals from the green base, using kitchen scissors if helpful. Rinse the petals gently under cool water and let them drain.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:306:"

Place the dandelion petals in a large glass jar or bowl. Pour 4 cups room-temperature filtered water over the petals and stir gently. Cover and let the petals steep at room temperature for 12 to 24 hours, until the water turns softly golden and mildly floral. Do not steep much longer than 24 hours.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:287:"

Line a fine-mesh sieve with cheesecloth or use a nut milk bag. Strain the dandelion mixture into a clean pitcher, gently pressing or squeezing the petals to remove as much liquid as possible. Discard the used petals. You should have about 3½ to 4 cups of dandelion-infused water.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:252:"

Add 1 cup fresh lemon juice to the pitcher. Stir in ¾ cup honey or simple syrup, 2 cups cold filtered water, and a pinch of sea salt. If using thick honey, warm it slightly first so it blends more easily. Taste and add more sweetener if needed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:4;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 5";s:4:"text";s:151:"

Refrigerate the lemonade for at least 1 hour before serving. Pour over ice and garnish with lemon slices, mint, or a few clean dandelion petals.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Use only dandelions gathered from clean, unsprayed areas and avoid roadsides, treated lawns, public walkways, parks, or places where pets may have wandered. Use yellow petals only, as the green parts can make the lemonade bitter. Do not steep longer than 24 hours. For a vegan version, replace honey with simple syrup, agave, maple syrup, or organic cane sugar syrup. Store covered in the refrigerator for up to 5 days and stir before serving.

item.content:encoded: A creamy, bold, and slightly spicy sauce made with mayonnaise, sriracha, and lime juice. This quick homemade sriracha mayo instantly upgrades fries, burgers, tacos, sushi, rice bowls, sandwiches, and more with rich flavor and smooth heat.

item.title: Cool Cucumber Yogurt Dip
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A refreshing Mediterranean-inspired cucumber yogurt dip made with creamy Greek yogurt, grated cucumber, fresh dill, lemon juice, and garlic. Light, cooling, and perfect as a dip or sauce for warm weather meals.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:4:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:145:"

Grate the cucumber finely, then place it in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out excess moisture to prevent the dip from becoming watery.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:139:"

In a mixing bowl, combine Greek yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper. Stir until smooth and creamy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:111:"

Fold in the grated cucumber and chopped dill, mixing gently until evenly distributed throughout the dip.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:136:"

Cover and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the dip to become extra refreshing before serving.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For best texture, always squeeze excess moisture from the cucumber before mixing. Greek yogurt gives the creamiest base, but you can substitute with thick plant-based yogurt for a vegan version. Letting the dip chill for at least 20 minutes helps the flavors meld beautifully.

Variations: swap dill for mint for a fresher flavor, add chili flakes for heat, or mix in a spoon of sour cream for extra creaminess. Store in the refrigerator for up to 3–4 days in an airtight container and stir before serving.

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:4:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:132:"

item.content:encoded: A cool, creamy, and tangy dill pickle dip packed with rich cream cheese, sour cream, and crunchy pickles. This addictive appetizer delivers bold pickle flavor in every bite and disappears fast at parties.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

item.title: Roasted Red Pepper Dip
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A smooth, smoky, and creamy roasted red pepper dip packed with bold Mediterranean flavor. Sweet roasted peppers blend with cream cheese, garlic, olive oil, and smoked paprika for an easy appetizer that works beautifully with pita chips, vegetables, sandwiches, and wraps.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: a:5:{i:0;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:1221;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:25:"food processor or blender";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:1;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:248;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:11:"mixing bowl";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:2;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:218;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:16:"measuring spoons";s:5:"notes";s:0:"";}i:3;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:365;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:12:"paper towels";s:5:"notes";s:27:"optional for drying peppers";}i:4;a:4:{s:2:"id";i:1163;s:6:"amount";s:0:"";s:4:"name";s:18:"airtight container";s:5:"notes";s:11:"for storage";}}

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:4:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:132:"

Drain the roasted red peppers well to prevent the dip from becoming watery. Pat them dry lightly with paper towels if needed.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:194:"

Add the roasted red peppers, cream cheese, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to a food processor or blender. Blend until completely smooth and creamy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:137:"

Taste the dip and adjust seasoning if needed. Add extra lemon juice for brightness or more smoked paprika for deeper smoky flavor.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:148:"

Transfer the dip to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes before serving. This helps the flavors blend together beautifully.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Drain roasted peppers well before blending to avoid a watery dip. For extra tanginess, blend in feta cheese. Add red pepper flakes or cayenne for heat, or use Greek yogurt for a lighter texture. Chill before serving to help the flavors fully develop. This dip can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Sweet Chili Cream Sauce
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A creamy, sweet, tangy, and slightly spicy dipping sauce made with mayonnaise and sweet chili sauce. This quick 5-minute sauce pairs perfectly with fries, shrimp, tacos, burgers, spring rolls, and roasted vegetables.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:3:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:79:"

In a medium bowl, add the mayonnaise, sweet chili sauce, and lime juice.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:138:"

Whisk thoroughly until the sauce becomes creamy, smooth, and evenly combined. Taste and adjust sweetness or spice level if desired.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:116:"

For the best flavor, refrigerate the sauce for 10 to 15 minutes before serving so the flavors blend together.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

For extra heat, add sriracha or red pepper flakes gradually. For a lighter version, replace part of the mayonnaise with Greek yogurt. Chill for 10 to 15 minutes before serving for the best flavor. Do not freeze, as the texture may separate after thawing.
a:3:{s:4:"type";s:6:"rating";s:7:"message";s:37:"There are no ratings for your recipe.";s:8:"priority";i:15;}

item.title: Creamy Buffalo Ranch Dip
item.dc:creator: Adelaide
item.content:encoded: A bold, tangy, slightly spicy dip perfect for parties and game days. This creamy buffalo ranch dip combines cool ranch flavor with buttery buffalo heat for a smooth and irresistible dip that pairs perfectly with fries, wings, vegetables, chips, and more.

a:1:{i:0;a:3:{s:12:"instructions";a:4:{i:0;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 1";s:4:"text";s:94:"

In a medium bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise and sour cream until smooth and creamy.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:1;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 2";s:4:"text";s:132:"

Stir in the buffalo sauce, ranch seasoning, and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until the dip becomes smooth and evenly combined.

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:2;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 3";s:4:"text";s:150:"

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}i:3;a:5:{s:3:"uid";i:-1;s:4:"name";s:6:"Step 4";s:4:"text";s:143:"

";s:5:"image";i:0;s:11:"ingredients";a:0:{}}}s:4:"name";s:0:"";s:3:"uid";i:-1;}}

Refrigerate before serving for the best texture and flavor. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. Not freezer friendly.
